MAIN PURPOSE OF THE ROLE
 
Are you a search engine guru? Can you find what you're looking for with just a few keywords? We have a unique opportunity for you to put your skills to the test!

Welocalize is looking for an Portuguese (Brazil) speaker in Brazil to help support our client's project as Junior Quality Coordinator.

MAIN DUTIES

You will be the junior coordinator of our Search Quality Rater project.
You will complete tasks both in Portuguese (Brazil) and English (US).

The following is a non-exhaustive list of responsibilities and areas of ownership of the Junior Quality Coordinator:

Performance Analysis 
・May analyze data on quality performance, produce statistical quality reports, monitor progress, and create related documentation - with support from Quality Coordinators.
・Completes Internal Assessments.
・ Provides feedback on blind test ranges and queries coming from the team.
・ May provide ad-hoc support to raters and educate them on best practices and client’s expectations.
・Flags raters that show any behavioral concerns.
・ May analyze RCAs provided by resources and request clarifications, as necessary.

Training and support  
・ May participate in the creation/review of new training material, including best practices, newsletters, webinars, and others.

Analytics, Reporting, Knowledge, and Asset Management  
・May keep track of data and analyze the data.

Communication 
・May attend meetings with different stakeholders as applicable - with support of Quality Coordinators. 
・ Monitors raters’ queries.

Other
・ May perform other program-specific tasks needed to achieve OKRs.

Project Details

Location: Remote, Brazil-based
Hours: Part time: 20hours/week, Full time: 40hours/week
Start date: ASAP
Employment Type: Freelance/Independent Contract

    Als Ads Quality Rater beoordeel en evalueer je internetadvertenties om ze beter en relevanter te maken voor eindgebruikers zoals jijzelf.
     
    Met andere woorden, je vertelt het systeem hoe goed of hoe slecht een advertentie is op basis van je begrip van de trefwoorden die bij elke advertentie verstrekt worden. Je beoordeelt advertenties zowel in het Engels als in het Nederlands.
     
    Deze functie is ideaal voor mensen die:
    ·        Dagelijks op het internet surfen
    ·        Vaak grote zoekmachines gebruiken
    ·        Advertenties herkennen wanneer ze verschijnen
    ·        Houden van online onderzoek doen over verschillende onderwerpen
     
    Daarnaast moeten alle Ads Quality Raters een geheimhoudingsovereenkomst ondertekenen en slagen voor een door de klant verstrekte test voordat ze worden aangenomen.
     
    Deze cruciale stappen garanderen geheimhouding van de klant en een hoog kwaliteitsniveau.
     
    Projectdetails
    Functieomschrijving: Ads Quality Rater
    Salaris: per taak (ca. $17 USD per uur)
    Locatie: op afstand, Nederland
    Uren: bepaal je eigen schema gebaseerd op het volgende: minimale inzet is 10 uur per week. Je kunt ervoor kiezen om tot 20 uur per week te werken (als het project dit toelaat).
    Startdatum: zo snel mogelijk
    Dienstverband: freelance; betaling elke 2 weken
    Projectduur: 12 maanden (met mogelijkheid tot verlenging)
    De hoeveelheid van data kan van week tot week variëren. Sommige weken is er meer data om te beoordelen, andere weken minder. Van alle Ads Quality Raters wordt verwacht dat zij minimaal 10 uur per week werken.
     
    Aanwervingsproces en stappen
    Welo Data streeft naar een inclusief en rechtvaardig wervingsproces. Alle kandidaten dienen de volgende stappen doorlopen om in aanmerking te komen voor dit project:
    •           Sollicitatie kandidaat
    •           Welo Data beoordeling sollicitatie
    •           Kennis, evaluatie en kwalificatie kandidaat
    •           Welo Data’s klant beoordeling
    •           Definitieve goedkeuring
    Het wervingsproces kan tot 14 dagen in beslag nemen.

    About the Role

    Welo Data is seeking experienced linguists to support a synthetic data generation program for a leading technology client. In this role, you will perform A/B preference testing of machine-generated translations from English into Indic languages, helping to evaluate and improve the quality of AI-generated content. 

    As a Translation Validator, you will independently review an English source document alongside two machine-generated translations (Variant A and Variant B), select the preferred translation, and provide a written justification for your choice. Each sample is reviewed by three independent validators working in a blind process.

    Project Details

    • Job Title: Translation Validation - Assamese
    • Location: Remote 
    • Employment Type: Freelance Contract 

    What You’ll Do

    • Review English source documents alongside two machine-generated Assamese translations.
    • Evaluate both variants based on accuracy, fluency, and overall translation quality.
    • Select the preferred translation and provide a clear written justification for your assessment.
    • Review audio files and their corresponding transcriptions, evaluating accuracy, completeness, and overall quality.
    • Assess both transcription quality and audio quality according to project guidelines.
    • Complete assigned samples independently and within established timelines.
    • Adhere strictly to project and client guidelines

    Requirements:

    • Native-level fluency in Assamese (written and spoken).
    • Strong written communication skills in the target language.
    • Proficiency in English.
    • Background in linguistics, translation, or language quality assessment preferred.
    • Ability to work independently with high attention to detail and consistency.
    • Familiarity with Romanized script conventions for the relevant language is a plus (for transliteration tasks).
    Why Join Welo Data?  
    ✨ Limitless Flexibility  
    Project-based opportunities that fit your availability. Choose when and how much you want to contribute—fully remote, with complete autonomy.   
    🌱 Limitless Growth  
    Optional access to AI and Large Language Model workshops designed specifically for professionals like you. No coding required—just your expertise.   
    🌍 Limitless Support  
    Be part of a global contributor community with responsive guidance and support.   
    💡 Real Impact  
    Apply your expertise in the Legal field to influence the AI systems shaping the future of your industry—while collaborating with data professionals and expanding your skills.

    About Welo Data

    Welo Data, a Welo Global brand, is the multilingual data and evaluation partner for foundation labs and enterprises deploying GenAI systems globally. They deliver the human judgment, data infrastructure, and evaluation systems that ensure AI models perform reliably across languages, cultures, and real-world contexts, at every stage from training through deployment.  Its global network of 500,000+ vetted experts spans 300+ languages and locales, enabling high-quality multilingual data creation and structured model evaluation across the full spectrum of modern AI applications — from large language models and voice and speech systems to agentic workflows and robotics and embodied AI.     Welo Data is building a global network of linguists, language enthusiasts, and culturally aware contributors to shape safer, smarter AI.

    Note: This is not an active job opening. By applying, you’ll join our global contributor network. When a project aligns with your skills and availability, we’ll reach out with all the details, including scope, timeline, and compensation.

    - Native or near-native fluency in Flemish
    - Based in: Belgium
    - English proficiency
    - Comfortable with digital tools
    - Detail-oriented and curious
     
    Why Join Us?
    🚀 Limitless You – Work when and where you want, with room to grow
    🤖 Limitless AI – Contribute to smarter, more inclusive AI
    🌎 Be Part of Us – Join a global, supportive community

    Welo Data projects vary by scope and complexity, but all play a role in building more accurate, inclusive, and human-centered AI.
    Depending on your skills, you might:
    📝 Annotate or label text, images, or audio to train AI systems
    🔍 Evaluate search results, ads, or chatbot responses for quality and relevance
    💬 Create and test prompts to improve large language models (LLMs)
    🌍 Ensure content reflects cultural, linguistic, or industry-specific accuracy
    Some projects last a few days; others may extend over several weeks. Before each one, you’ll receive clear details on tasks, timelines, and compensation, so you can decide what works best for you.
     
    How to Apply?
    Click the “Apply” button on our website to fill out a short form and join our talent database. It only takes a few minutes to get started and become part of our growing community.
     
    📬Questions?
    If you have any questions about the process, feel free to contact us at TalentRequests@welocalize.com.

    At Welocalize, we're dedicated to powering human-centered AI with high-quality language data. We're growing a global community of language professionals and enthusiasts, and we're looking for talented individuals to join us! If you're passionate about how language and technology intersect, this is your opportunity to help shape the future of inclusive, human-centered AI.
     
    In these remote roles, you'll contribute to high-quality language data that powers cutting-edge AI systems. You'll be part of a vibrant community, taking on task-based projects in areas such as:
    - Annotation
    - Evaluation
    - Prompt Creation
     
    When a suitable project becomes available, we'll invite you to a brief qualification process that may include training, assessments, or onboarding, depending on the project's specific needs.
     
    Projects You Might Work On:
     
    You might find yourself contributing to AI in diverse ways, for example:
     
    Supporting AI Language Data for Korean, Chinese or both
     
    If you have native or near-native in Korean, Chinese or both fluency, you'll contribute to improving AI systems by engaging with a wide variety of language-focused tasks. This could include annotation, evaluation, or prompt creation, all aimed at enhancing AI's understanding and use of the languages
     
    Evaluating Machine Transliterated Lyrics (Korean to Chinese)
     
    For those with native-level or near-native proficiency in transliterating Korean to Chinese (Simplified) script, you'll play a crucial role in assessing the quality and accuracy of machine-transliterated song lyrics. This involves reviewing and evaluating lyrics for meaning, fluency, and naturalness, providing quality ratings based on predefined criteria, and identifying and correcting errors in transliteration. Your feedback will directly contribute to improving automated transliteration systems. Familiarity with different music genres and lyrical styles is a plus.
     
    What We're Looking For:
     
    - We're seeking detail-oriented, curious, and adaptable individuals eager to engage with language and technology
    - Native or near-native fluency in the Korean and Chinese 
    - Proficient in English (both written and spoken).Comfortable using digital tools and working remotely.
    - Ability to focus on detail and maintain concentration over large volumes of content.
    - Previous experience in translation, localization, or linguistic quality evaluation is a plus but not required.
    - Experience using online evaluation tools or platforms is a nice-to-have.
     
    Geographic Requirements
    We accept candidates from a wide range of countries, including but not limited to: China, South Korea, United States
     
    All work is freelance, offers flexible scheduling, and is ongoing based on project needs. For some projects, candidates who get onboarded and complete 10 hours in the first week may receive a reimbursement for 1 hour of their evaluated hourly rate as part of a learning program.

    At Welo Data, Limitless AI. Limitless You. isn’t just a slogan—it’s our promise. We build smarter AI through the power of human contribution, offering limitless opportunities for our global community to grow, contribute, and work on their terms.

    AI의 미래를 당신의 방식으로 함께 만들어가세요 | AIの未来をあなたの手で形作りましょう
     
    Welo Data에서 우리는 고품질 언어 데이터를 통해 인간 중심의 AI를 지원합니다. Welo Data의 일원이 되어 전 세계 고객들과 함께 언어를 통해 기술을 더욱 포용적으로 만드세요.
     
    Welo Dataでは、高品質な言語データを通じて人間中心のAIを支えています。Welo Dataの一員として、世界中のクライアントと共に、言語を活用してより包括的な技術を実現していきましょう。
     
    우리는 전 세계 언어학자, 언어 애호가, 문화적으로 민감한 기여자들의 커뮤니티를 확장하고 있습니다. 원격 근무, 유연한 스케줄, 그리고 의미 있는 작업을 통해 주석 작업, 평가, 프롬프트 생성과 같은 기회를 탐색하세요.
     
    私たちは、言語学者、言語愛好家、文化への理解が深い貢献者からなるグローバルなコミュニティを拡大しています。リモートで柔軟に働きながら、アノテーション、評価、プロンプト作成といった意義のある仕事に挑戦してみませんか

    한국어 및 일본어 원어민 수준 또는 이에 준하는 능력 | 韓国語および日本語のネイティブまたはそれに近い流暢さ
    한국, 일본, 미국, 캐나다, 중국, 호주, 영국, 베트남, 싱가포르, 독일, 필리핀, 인도네시아, 브라질, 말레이시아, 멕시코, 프랑스, 뉴질랜드, 아르헨티나 | 韓国、日本、アメリカ、カナダ、中国、オーストラリア、イギリス、ベトナム、シンガポール、ドイツ、フィリピン、インドネシア、ブラジル、マレーシア、メキシコ、フランス、ニュージーランド、アルゼンチン
    영어 능통 | 英語力がある方
    디지털 도구에 익숙한 분 | デジタルツールに慣れている方
    꼼꼼하고 호기심 많은 분 | 細部に注意を払える好奇心旺盛な方
     
     
    왜 우리와 함께 해야 할까요?
    🚀 무한한 가능성 – 원하는 시간과 장소에서 일하며 성장할 기회
    🤖 무한한 AI – 더 스마트하고 포용적인 AI에 기여

    🚀 無限の可能性 – 好きな時間と場所で働き、成長の機会を得られます

    Welo Data, part of Welocalize, is a global AI data company with 500,000+ contributors delivering high-quality, ethical data to train the world’s most advanced AI systems. We’re building smarter, more human AI with a diverse community in 100+ countries.

    At Welo Data, Limitless AI. Limitless You. isn’t just a slogan—it’s our promise. We build smarter AI through the power of human contribution, offering limitless opportunities for our global community to grow, contribute, and work on their terms.

    Are you detail-oriented and curious about tech?
     
    Welo Data is building a global network of linguists, language enthusiasts, and culturally aware contributors to shape safer, smarter AI.
     
    By joining our talent community, you’ll be first in line for flexible, remote projects in annotation, evaluation, and prompt creation—always on your terms.

    - Based in: Worldwide, Remote

    - Comfortable with digital tools
    - Detail-oriented and curious

    🚀 Limitless You – Work when and where you want, with room to grow
    🤖 Limitless AI – Contribute to smarter, more inclusive AI
    🌎 Be Part of Us – Join a global, supportive community
     
    About our projects:
    Welo Data projects vary by scope and complexity, but all play a role in building more accurate, inclusive, and human-centered AI.
     
    Depending on your skills, you might:
    📝 Annotate or label text, images, or audio to train AI systems
    🔍 Evaluate search results, ads, or chatbot responses for quality and relevance
    💬 Create and test prompts to improve large language models (LLMs)
    🌍 Ensure content reflects cultural, linguistic, or industry-specific accuracy
    Some projects last a few days; others may extend over several weeks. Before each one, you’ll receive clear details on tasks, timelines, and compensation, so you can decide what works best for you.
     
    How to Apply?
    Click the “Apply” button on our website to fill out a short form and join our talent database. It only takes a few minutes to get started and become part of our growing community.
     
    📬Questions?
    If you have any questions about the process, feel free to contact us at TalentRequests@welocalize.com.

- Native or near-native fluency in Odia
- Based in: India, Remote
- English proficiency
- Comfortable with digital tools
- Detail-oriented and curious

🚀 Limitless You – Work when and where you want, with room to grow
🤖 Limitless AI – Contribute to smarter, more inclusive AI
🌎 Be Part of Us – Join a global, supportive community

📝 Annotate or label text, images, or audio to train AI systems
🔍 Evaluate search results, ads, or chatbot responses for quality and relevance
💬 Create and test prompts to improve large language models (LLMs)
🌍 Ensure content reflects cultural, linguistic, or industry-specific accuracy
Some projects last a few days; others may extend over several weeks. Before each one, you’ll receive clear details on tasks, timelines, and compensation, so you can decide what works best for you.
 
How to Apply?
Click the “Apply” button on our website to fill out a short form and join our talent database. It only takes a few minutes to get started and become part of our growing community.

Welo Data, part of Welocalize, is a global AI data company with 500,000+ contributors delivering high-quality, ethical data to train the world’s most advanced AI systems. We’re building smarter, more human AI with a diverse community in 100+ countries.

At Welo Data, Limitless AI. Limitless You. isn’t just a slogan—it’s our promise. We build smarter AI through the power of human contribution, offering limitless opportunities for our global community to grow, contribute, and work on their terms.

Are you detail-oriented and curious about tech?
 
Welo Data is building a global network of linguists, language enthusiasts, and culturally aware contributors to shape safer, smarter AI.
 
By joining our talent community, you’ll be first in line for flexible, remote projects in annotation, evaluation, and prompt creation—always on your terms.
 
Note: This is not an active job opening. By applying, you’ll join our global contributor network. When a project aligns with your skills and availability, we’ll reach out with all the details, including scope, timeline, and compensation.
 
What You’ll Need
- Native or near-native fluency in Sinhala
- Based in: Sri Lanka, Remote
- English proficiency
- Comfortable with digital tools
- Detail-oriented and curious
 
Why Join Us?
🚀 Limitless You – Work when and where you want, with room to grow
🤖 Limitless AI – Contribute to smarter, more inclusive AI
🌎 Be Part of Us – Join a global, supportive community
 
About our projects:
Welo Data projects vary by scope and complexity, but all play a role in building more accurate, inclusive, and human-centered AI.
 
Depending on your skills, you might:
📝 Annotate or label text, images, or audio to train AI systems
🔍 Evaluate search results, ads, or chatbot responses for quality and relevance
💬 Create and test prompts to improve large language models (LLMs)
🌍 Ensure content reflects cultural, linguistic, or industry-specific accuracy
Some projects last a few days; others may extend over several weeks. Before each one, you’ll receive clear details on tasks, timelines, and compensation, so you can decide what works best for you.
 
How to Apply?
Click the “Apply” button on our website to fill out a short form and join our talent database. It only takes a few minutes to get started and become part of our growing community.
 
📬Questions?
If you have any questions about the process, feel free to contact us at TalentRequests@welocalize.com.

Welo Data, part of Welocalize, is a global AI data company with 500,000+ contributors delivering high-quality, ethical data to train the world’s most advanced AI systems. We’re building smarter, more human AI with a diverse community in 100+ countries.

At Welo Data, Limitless AI. Limitless You. isn’t just a slogan—it’s our promise. We build smarter AI through the power of human contribution, offering limitless opportunities for our global community to grow, contribute, and work on their terms.

Are you detail-oriented and curious about tech?
 
Welo Data is building a global network of linguists, language enthusiasts, and culturally aware contributors to shape safer, smarter AI.
 
By joining our talent community, you’ll be first in line for flexible, remote projects in annotation, evaluation, and prompt creation—always on your terms.
 
Note: This is not an active job opening. By applying, you’ll join our global contributor network. When a project aligns with your skills and availability, we’ll reach out with all the details, including scope, timeline, and compensation.
 
What You’ll Need
- Native or near-native fluency in Somali
- Based in: Worldwide, Remote
- English proficiency
- Comfortable with digital tools
- Detail-oriented and curious
 
Why Join Us?
🚀 Limitless You – Work when and where you want, with room to grow
🤖 Limitless AI – Contribute to smarter, more inclusive AI
🌎 Be Part of Us – Join a global, supportive community
 
About our projects:
Welo Data projects vary by scope and complexity, but all play a role in building more accurate, inclusive, and human-centered AI.
Depending on your skills, you might:
📝 Annotate or label text, images, or audio to train AI systems
🔍 Evaluate search results, ads, or chatbot responses for quality and relevance
💬 Create and test prompts to improve large language models (LLMs)
🌍 Ensure content reflects cultural, linguistic, or industry-specific accuracy
Some projects last a few days; others may extend over several weeks. Before each one, you’ll receive clear details on tasks, timelines, and compensation, so you can decide what works best for you.
 
How to Apply?
Click the “Apply” button on our website to fill out a short form and join our talent database. It only takes a few minutes to get started and become part of our growing community.
 
📬 Questions?
If you have any questions about the process, feel free to contact us at TalentRequests@welocalize.com.

Welo Data, part of Welocalize, is a global AI data company with 500,000+ contributors delivering high-quality, ethical data to train the world’s most advanced AI systems. We’re building smarter, more human AI with a diverse community in 100+ countries.

At Welo Data, Limitless AI. Limitless You. isn’t just a slogan—it’s our promise. We build smarter AI through the power of human contribution, offering limitless opportunities for our global community to grow, contribute, and work on their terms.

Are you detail-oriented and curious about tech?
 
Welo Data is building a global network of linguists, language enthusiasts, and culturally aware contributors to shape safer, smarter AI.
 
By joining our talent community, you’ll be first in line for flexible, remote projects in annotation, evaluation, and prompt creation—always on your terms.
 
Note: This is not an active job opening. By applying, you’ll join our global contributor network. When a project aligns with your skills and availability, we’ll reach out with all the details, including scope, timeline, and compensation.
 
What You’ll Need
- Native or near-native fluency in Sundanese
- Based in: Worldwide, Remote
- English proficiency
- Comfortable with digital tools
- Detail-oriented and curious
 
Why Join Us?
🚀 Limitless You – Work when and where you want, with room to grow
🤖 Limitless AI – Contribute to smarter, more inclusive AI
🌎 Be Part of Us – Join a global, supportive community
 
About our projects:
Welo Data projects vary by scope and complexity, but all play a role in building more accurate, inclusive, and human-centered AI.
Depending on your skills, you might:
📝 Annotate or label text, images, or audio to train AI systems
🔍 Evaluate search results, ads, or chatbot responses for quality and relevance
💬 Create and test prompts to improve large language models (LLMs)
🌍 Ensure content reflects cultural, linguistic, or industry-specific accuracy
Some projects last a few days; others may extend over several weeks. Before each one, you’ll receive clear details on tasks, timelines, and compensation, so you can decide what works best for you.
 
How to Apply?
Click the “Apply” button on our website to fill out a short form and join our talent database. It only takes a few minutes to get started and become part of our growing community.
 
📬 Questions?
If you have any questions about the process, feel free to contact us at TalentRequests@welocalize.com.

Welo Data, part of Welocalize, is a global AI data company with 500,000+ contributors delivering high-quality, ethical data to train the world’s most advanced AI systems. We’re building smarter, more human AI with a diverse community in 100+ countries.

At Welo Data, Limitless AI. Limitless You. isn’t just a slogan—it’s our promise. We build smarter AI through the power of human contribution, offering limitless opportunities for our global community to grow, contribute, and work on their terms.

Are you detail-oriented and curious about tech?
 
Welo Data is building a global network of linguists, language enthusiasts, and culturally aware contributors to shape safer, smarter AI.
 
By joining our talent community, you’ll be first in line for flexible, remote projects in annotation, evaluation, and prompt creation—always on your terms.
 
Note: This is not an active job opening. By applying, you’ll join our global contributor network. When a project aligns with your skills and availability, we’ll reach out with all the details, including scope, timeline, and compensation.
 
What You’ll Need
- Native or near-native fluency in Tagalog
- Based in: Worldwide, Remote
- English proficiency
- Comfortable with digital tools
- Detail-oriented and curious
 
Why Join Us?
🚀 Limitless You – Work when and where you want, with room to grow
🤖 Limitless AI – Contribute to smarter, more inclusive AI
🌎 Be Part of Us – Join a global, supportive community
 
About our projects:
Welo Data projects vary by scope and complexity, but all play a role in building more accurate, inclusive, and human-centered AI.
Depending on your skills, you might:
📝 Annotate or label text, images, or audio to train AI systems
🔍 Evaluate search results, ads, or chatbot responses for quality and relevance
💬 Create and test prompts to improve large language models (LLMs)
🌍 Ensure content reflects cultural, linguistic, or industry-specific accuracy
Some projects last a few days; others may extend over several weeks. Before each one, you’ll receive clear details on tasks, timelines, and compensation, so you can decide what works best for you.
 
How to Apply?
Click the “Apply” button on our website to fill out a short form and join our talent database. It only takes a few minutes to get started and become part of our growing community.
 
📬 Questions?
If you have any questions about the process, feel free to contact us at TalentRequests@welocalize.com.

- English proficiency

🤖 Limitless AI – Contribute to smarter, more inclusive AI
🌎 Be Part of Us – Join a global, supportive community

Welo Data projects vary by scope and complexity, but all play a role in building more accurate, inclusive, and human-centered AI.
Depending on your skills, you might:
📝 Annotate or label text, images, or audio to train AI systems
🔍 Evaluate search results, ads, or chatbot responses for quality and relevance
💬 Create and test prompts to improve large language models (LLMs)
🌍 Ensure content reflects cultural, linguistic, or industry-specific accuracy

How to Apply?
Click the “Apply” button on our website to fill out a short form and join our talent database. It only takes a few minutes to get started and become part of our growing community.
 
📬Questions?
If you have any questions about the process, feel free to contact us at TalentRequests@welocalize.com.

Welo Data, part of Welocalize, is a global AI data company with 500,000+ contributors delivering high-quality, ethical data to train the world’s most advanced AI systems. We’re building smarter, more human AI with a diverse community in 100+ countries.

At Welo Data, Limitless AI. Limitless You. isn’t just a slogan—it’s our promise. We build smarter AI through the power of human contribution, offering limitless opportunities for our global community to grow, contribute, and work on their terms.

Are you detail-oriented and curious about tech?
 
Welo Data is building a global network of linguists, language enthusiasts, and culturally aware contributors to shape safer, smarter AI.
 
By joining our talent community, you’ll be first in line for flexible, remote projects in annotation, evaluation, and prompt creation—always on your terms.
 
Note: This is not an active job opening. By applying, you’ll join our global contributor network. When a project aligns with your skills and availability, we’ll reach out with all the details, including scope, timeline, and compensation.
 
What You’ll Need
- Native or near-native fluency in Turkish
- Based in: Turkey, Cyprus
- English proficiency
- Comfortable with digital tools
- Detail-oriented and curious
 
Why Join Us?
🚀 Limitless You – Work when and where you want, with room to grow
🤖 Limitless AI – Contribute to smarter, more inclusive AI
🌎 Be Part of Us – Join a global, supportive community
 
About our projects:
Welo Data projects vary by scope and complexity, but all play a role in building more accurate, inclusive, and human-centered AI.
Depending on your skills, you might:
📝 Annotate or label text, images, or audio to train AI systems
🔍 Evaluate search results, ads, or chatbot responses for quality and relevance
💬 Create and test prompts to improve large language models (LLMs)
🌍 Ensure content reflects cultural, linguistic, or industry-specific accuracy
Some projects last a few days; others may extend over several weeks. Before each one, you’ll receive clear details on tasks, timelines, and compensation, so you can decide what works best for you.
 
How to Apply?
Click the “Apply” button on our website to fill out a short form and join our talent database. It only takes a few minutes to get started and become part of our growing community.
 
📬Questions?
If you have any questions about the process, feel free to contact us at TalentRequests@welocalize.com.

Welo Data, part of Welocalize, is a global AI data company with 500,000+ contributors delivering high-quality, ethical data to train the world’s most advanced AI systems. We’re building smarter, more human AI with a diverse community in 100+ countries.

At Welo Data, Limitless AI. Limitless You. isn’t just a slogan—it’s our promise. We build smarter AI through the power of human contribution, offering limitless opportunities for our global community to grow, contribute, and work on their terms.

Are you detail-oriented and curious about tech?
 
Welo Data is building a global network of linguists, language enthusiasts, and culturally aware contributors to shape safer, smarter AI.
 
By joining our talent community, you’ll be first in line for flexible, remote projects in annotation, evaluation, and prompt creation—always on your terms.
 
Note: This is not an active job opening. By applying, you’ll join our global contributor network. When a project aligns with your skills and availability, we’ll reach out with all the details, including scope, timeline, and compensation.
 
What You’ll Need
- Native or near-native fluency in Urdu
- Based in: India, Qatar
- English proficiency
- Comfortable with digital tools
- Detail-oriented and curious
 
Why Join Us?
🚀 Limitless You – Work when and where you want, with room to grow
🤖 Limitless AI – Contribute to smarter, more inclusive AI
🌎 Be Part of Us – Join a global, supportive community
 
About our projects:
Welo Data projects vary by scope and complexity, but all play a role in building more accurate, inclusive, and human-centered AI.
Depending on your skills, you might:
📝 Annotate or label text, images, or audio to train AI systems
🔍 Evaluate search results, ads, or chatbot responses for quality and relevance
💬 Create and test prompts to improve large language models (LLMs)
🌍 Ensure content reflects cultural, linguistic, or industry-specific accuracy
Some projects last a few days; others may extend over several weeks. Before each one, you’ll receive clear details on tasks, timelines, and compensation, so you can decide what works best for you.
 
How to Apply?
Click the “Apply” button on our website to fill out a short form and join our talent database. It only takes a few minutes to get started and become part of our growing community.
 
📬 Questions?
If you have any questions about the process, feel free to contact us at TalentRequests@welocalize.com.

Welo Data, part of Welocalize, is a global AI data company with 500,000+ contributors delivering high-quality, ethical data to train the world’s most advanced AI systems. We’re building smarter, more human AI with a diverse community in 100+ countries.

At Welo Data, Limitless AI. Limitless You. isn’t just a slogan—it’s our promise. We build smarter AI through the power of human contribution, offering limitless opportunities for our global community to grow, contribute, and work on their terms.

Are you detail-oriented and curious about tech?
 
Welo Data is building a global network of linguists, language enthusiasts, and culturally aware contributors to shape safer, smarter AI.
 
By joining our talent community, you’ll be first in line for flexible, remote projects in annotation, evaluation, and prompt creation—always on your terms.
 
Note: This is not an active job opening. By applying, you’ll join our global contributor network. When a project aligns with your skills and availability, we’ll reach out with all the details, including scope, timeline, and compensation.
 
What You’ll Need
- Native or near-native fluency in Welsh
- Based in: United Kingdom, Remote
- English proficiency
- Comfortable with digital tools
- Detail-oriented and curious
 
Why Join Us?
🚀 Limitless You – Work when and where you want, with room to grow
🤖 Limitless AI – Contribute to smarter, more inclusive AI
🌎 Be Part of Us – Join a global, supportive community
 
About our projects:
Welo Data projects vary by scope and complexity, but all play a role in building more accurate, inclusive, and human-centered AI.
 
Depending on your skills, you might:
📝 Annotate or label text, images, or audio to train AI systems
🔍 Evaluate search results, ads, or chatbot responses for quality and relevance
💬 Create and test prompts to improve large language models (LLMs)
🌍 Ensure content reflects cultural, linguistic, or industry-specific accuracy
Some projects last a few days; others may extend over several weeks. Before each one, you’ll receive clear details on tasks, timelines, and compensation, so you can decide what works best for you.
 
How to Apply?
Click the “Apply” button on our website to fill out a short form and join our talent database. It only takes a few minutes to get started and become part of our growing community.
 
📬Questions?
If you have any questions about the process, feel free to contact us at TalentRequests@welocalize.com.

This breadth of linguistic, cultural, and domain expertise enables Welo Data to address critical AI development challenges, including safety, bias, inclusivity, and cross-lingual reliability. A unified global operating model, led by specialized program and quality experts and grounded in assessment-driven talent selection, localized rubrics, and continuous calibration, ensures consistent performance across languages, domains, and modalities. Underpinning all of this is NIMO™ (Network Identity Management and Operations), Welo Data's proprietary identity and fraud-prevention framework. Built to maintain data integrity and workforce trust across a global contributor base, NIMO combines advanced verification, continuous monitoring, and structured QA to ensure every dataset is accurate, traceable, and culturally grounded. welodata.ai    Role Purpose Manages complex, strategic AI training data projects. Owns end-to-end delivery, client relationships, and financial outcomes. Guides Project Coordinators, executes quality strategy in partnership with quality team, and drives process improvements and new service pilots. Assists in the management of complex projects that enable Generative AI capabilities for clients, guiding project coordinators and partnering with Quality on standards and continuous improvement. Key Responsibilities Program & Delivery Leadership: Execute delivery plans, milestones, resourcing, and controls for large or multi-workstream AI data projects (collection, labeling, evaluation). Client Management: Contribute to regular governance, status, and planning sessions; handle scope, priorities, and change. Financial Ownership: Track budgets, rates, and margins; manage forecasts, burn, and change orders to protect profitability. Quality Partnership: Share accountability with the Quality Analyst team for QA approach and continuous improvement loops. Resource & Capacity Planning: Plan and secure rater/annotator capacity; align training, shifts, and handoffs across time zones. Risk, Issue & Change Control: Run root-cause and corrective actions; escalate material risks with options and impact. Process & Service Innovation: Contribute to SOPs, templates, and dashboards; pilot new delivery methods and services for AI data programs. Compliance & Security: Ensure data handling, privacy, and security policies are followed across all workstreams. Reporting & Insights: Keep trackers and dashboards current; translate delivery data into clear, actionable insights for clients and leaders. Requirements  Education Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in business, data/operations, engineering, or related fields Experience 1+ years leading complex project delivery or operations (AI data, content review, annotation, labeling, or adjacent domains) Experience coordinating multi-team delivery and managing client touchpoints Skills Strong planning and organization across parallel workstreams Clear written and spoken communication with senior client stakeholders Solid use of spreadsheets, PM/task boards, and basic BI; comfort with ETL concepts is a plus Quality mindset with practical use of SOPs, QA gates, and acceptance criteria Financial awareness (budgets, margin, change orders) and sound trade-off judgment Coaching ability for junior PMs and Coordinators Confident escalation and negotiation to resolve risks, issues, and scope questions Comfortable working with global, distributed teams (intermediate to advanced English) Additional Qualifications (P1+) Near-native English with strong writing and editorial skills Hands-on experience with generative AI tools (text, voice, or video) Background in QA testing, rubric design, or AI safety/ethics evaluation Familiarity with data-annotation platforms and model-evaluation tools Ability to interpret code, datasets, and system workflows at a conceptual level (no coding required) Able to work independently and manage workflows effectively in a remote environment Multilingual ability beyond English Scope & Autonomy (P1 Alignment) Assists in leading one large strategic project or several medium projects end-to-end Executes delivery approach within scope, budget, and policies; escalates only non-standard or high-impact items Provides day-to-day direction to a small delivery pod (e.g., 2–8 Junior PMs/Coordinators) and influences cross-functional partners Shares accountability for quality outcomes with the Quality Analyst.     About Welo Data

    Welo Data, a Welo Global brand, is the multilingual data and evaluation partner for foundation labs and enterprises deploying GenAI systems globally. They deliver the human judgment, data infrastructure, and evaluation systems that ensure AI models perform reliably across languages, cultures, and real-world contexts, at every stage from training through deployment.  Its global network of 500,000+ vetted experts spans 300+ languages and locales, enabling high-quality multilingual data creation and structured model evaluation across the full spectrum of modern AI applications — from large language models and voice and speech systems to agentic workflows and robotics and embodied AI. This breadth of linguistic, cultural, and domain expertise enables Welo Data to address critical AI development challenges, including safety, bias, inclusivity, and cross-lingual reliability. A unified global operating model, led by specialized program and quality experts and grounded in assessment-driven talent selection, localized rubrics, and continuous calibration, ensures consistent performance across languages, domains, and modalities. Underpinning all of this is NIMO™ (Network Identity Management and Operations), Welo Data's proprietary identity and fraud-prevention framework. Built to maintain data integrity and workforce trust across a global contributor base, NIMO combines advanced verification, continuous monitoring, and structured QA to ensure every dataset is accurate, traceable, and culturally grounded. welodata.ai   


    Role Purpose

    Manages complex, strategic AI training data projects. Owns end-to-end delivery, client relationships, and financial outcomes. Guides Project Coordinators, executes quality strategy in partnership with quality team, and drives process improvements and new service pilots. Assists in the management of complex projects that enable Generative AI capabilities for clients, guiding project coordinators and partnering with Quality on standards and continuous improvement.

    Key Responsibilities

    • Program & Delivery Leadership: Execute delivery plans, milestones, resourcing, and controls for large or multi-workstream AI data projects (collection, labeling, evaluation).
    • Client Management: Contribute to regular governance, status, and planning sessions; handle scope, priorities, and change.
    • Financial Ownership: Track budgets, rates, and margins; manage forecasts, burn, and change orders to protect profitability.
    • Quality Partnership: Share accountability with the Quality Analyst team for QA approach and continuous improvement loops.
    • Resource & Capacity Planning: Plan and secure rater/annotator capacity; align training, shifts, and handoffs across time zones.
    • Risk, Issue & Change Control: Run root-cause and corrective actions; escalate material risks with options and impact.
    • Process & Service Innovation: Contribute to SOPs, templates, and dashboards; pilot new delivery methods and services for AI data programs.
    • Compliance & Security: Ensure data handling, privacy, and security policies are followed across all workstreams.
    • Reporting & Insights: Keep trackers and dashboards current; translate delivery data into clear, actionable insights for clients and leaders.

    Requirements 

    Education

    • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in business, data/operations, engineering, or related fields

    Experience

    • 1+ years leading complex project delivery or operations (AI data, content review, annotation, labeling, or adjacent domains)
    • Experience coordinating multi-team delivery and managing client touchpoints

    Skills

    • Strong planning and organization across parallel workstreams
    • Clear written and spoken communication with senior client stakeholders
    • Solid use of spreadsheets, PM/task boards, and basic BI; comfort with ETL concepts is a plus
    • Quality mindset with practical use of SOPs, QA gates, and acceptance criteria
    • Financial awareness (budgets, margin, change orders) and sound trade-off judgment
    • Coaching ability for junior PMs and Coordinators
    • Confident escalation and negotiation to resolve risks, issues, and scope questions
    • Comfortable working with global, distributed teams (intermediate to advanced English)

    Additional Qualifications (P1+)

    • Near-native English with strong writing and editorial skills
    • Hands-on experience with generative AI tools (text, voice, or video)
    • Background in QA testing, rubric design, or AI safety/ethics evaluation
    • Familiarity with data-annotation platforms and model-evaluation tools
    • Ability to interpret code, datasets, and system workflows at a conceptual level (no coding required)
    • Able to work independently and manage workflows effectively in a remote environment
    • Multilingual ability beyond English

    Scope & Autonomy (P1 Alignment)

    • Assists in leading one large strategic project or several medium projects end-to-end
    • Executes delivery approach within scope, budget, and policies; escalates only non-standard or high-impact items
    • Provides day-to-day direction to a small delivery pod (e.g., 2–8 Junior PMs/Coordinators) and influences cross-functional partners
    • Shares accountability for quality outcomes with the Quality Analyst.

    About Welocalize 

    Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
     
    Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com 

    JOB OVERVIEW
     
    We are looking for a Java Developer with hands-on experience in Java development. The role will primarily involve developing and supporting localization-related software/tools, along with enhancing and maintaining existing applications.
     
    The Associate Localization Software Engineer plays a crucial role in supporting localization and globalization efforts for software products. This individual is responsible for assisting in the implementation, execution, and maintenance of localization workflows, tools, and infrastructure to ensure successful delivery of localized content.
     
    TASKS & RESPONSIBILITIES
     Program Support
     
    • Assist in implementing localization workflows and managing production tools.
    • Perform basic troubleshooting and debugging of localization tools, files, and processes under guidance.
    • Maintain and update Translation Memories (TM) and glossaries.
    • Provide technical support to translation and production teams regarding tools and file formats.
     
    Program Implementation
    • Work on preparing and maintaining localization kits, ensuring content is properly formatted for translation.
    • Run file preparation, conversion, and QA checks using localization tools.
    • Execute defined localization production steps as outlined by senior team members.
     
    Quality Assurance and Troubleshooting
    • Conduct linguistic and functional QA checks on localized content.
    • Identify and resolve basic technical issues related to localization processes.
    • Collaborate with senior engineers to escalate and solve complex problems.
     
    Collaboration and Learning
    • Work closely with the production team, senior engineers, and Project Managers to ensure smooth execution of projects.
    • Participate in training sessions to enhance skills and gain knowledge of new tools and processes.
    Additional Job Description
     
    EDUCATION
    • Degree, diploma, or equivalent in a computer-related discipline and related experience in language or software localization
     
    SKILLS & KNOWLEDGE
     
    • 2-3 years of experience in software localization or a related field.
    • Core Java / Advanced Java
    • Spring Boot and REST APIs 
    • SQL and database knowledge
    • Debugging and troubleshooting
    • Application development and maintenance
    • Git and basic development practices.
     
    Job Reference: #LI-JC1

    About Welocalize 

    Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
     
    Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com 

    Summary:

    We are looking for a Technical Publication Engineer to manage, validate, develop, and publish technical documentation for global software products.

    The role covers the end-to-end publication lifecycle, including source-file management, localization readiness, documentation development, technical QA, defect resolution, and publishing. The ideal candidate should have experience with structured documentation, XML/Markdown, version control, localization workflows, and documentation QA.

    The role involves close collaboration with technical writers, localization teams, project managers, and client stakeholders to deliver accurate, consistent, and publication-ready content.

    ","id":"7903f79a-fe0f-46e3-ac8b-83b607574453","lists":[{"text":"Key Responsibilities","content":"

    Technical Documentation & Source Management

  • Retrieve, validate, and manage the correct and latest source files, assets, and documentation versions.
  • Analyse source content to determine translation/localization scope and prepare files for localization.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation using XML, Markdown, HTML, JSON, and other formats.
  • Validate document structure, metadata, links, references, and content integrity.
  • Manage version-controlled and single-source documentation and generate multiple publication outputs.

    • Localization & Quality Assurance

  • Validate source and translated files for structure, content, formatting, functionality, and localization readiness.
  • Perform technical, functional, and visual QA of documentation and published outputs.
  • Identify and resolve issues related to content, formatting, links, XML/Markdown, metadata, images, fonts, encoding, and rendering.
  • Compare source and localized content and track defects through appropriate systems.
  • Coordinate defect resolution and ensure issues are addressed before final publication.

    • Publishing

  • Configure and execute documentation publishing workflows.
  • Generate outputs such as online help, PDF, Word, CHM, HTML, and ZIP packages.
  • Troubleshoot build, transformation, publishing, and rendering issues.
  • Rebuild and republish documentation following corrections.
  • Ensure final outputs meet project and customer requirements.

    • Collaboration & Process Improvement

  • Work closely with documentation, localization, project management, and client teams.
  • Provide timely project updates and proactively communicate risks, issues, and dependencies.
  • Manage multiple requests while meeting quality and delivery timelines.
  • Identify process improvements that increase efficiency, quality, and reduce production risks.
  • Maintain work instructions, SOPs, and project documentation.
  • Demonstrate ownership, accountability, analytical thinking, and attention to detail.

    Localization & Defect Management: Phrase/Memsource, Jira

    Text & File Comparison: Beyond Compare, EmEditor, EditPlus, Sublime Text

    About Welocalize 

    Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
     
    Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com 

    ROLE OVERVIEW 

    Welocalize is looking for a native-level Bengali speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programme for a major global technology and communications client. 

    It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

    Welocalize is looking for a native-level Bengali speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme. 

    It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how it performs on a real device. You'll be among the first people to see this technology in Bengali, and your judgement shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it. 

    If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

     

    MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 

    • Review pre-release AI model output in Bengali and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material. 

    • Test the Bengali experience against the English one: confirm feature parity, complete a full user journey using non-English input, and check the product handles non-Latin script, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input correctly. 

    • Spot any display problem (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering badly) and any localization error — a wrong date, number, currency, unit, or a string left untranslated. 

    • Write up each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it: the step taken, the device and operating system, the locale, the build ID, and supporting evidence. Re-test once a fix lands to confirm it's resolved. 

    • Share your perspective as a native-level speaker on navigation, usability, and the language-specific nuance only a fluent speaker would catch. 

    • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office. Because of the confidential, pre-release nature of the technology, a remote or work-from-home arrangement isn't possible for this programme. 

    • Support other linguistic projects as needed. 

     

    JOB REQUIREMENTS  

    • Native-level or fully bilingual Bengali, written and spoken, with a current feel for how the language is really used day-to-day — every day and technical. 

    • Confidence with a smartphone and a laptop, and comfort moving between iOS and Android. 

    • A sharp eye for detail and fair, objective judgement when assessing quality. 

    • The ability to work independently, follow a detailed test script and guideline, and explain an issue clearly in English. 

    • Previous experience in software or app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus — though not essential if you bring the language skill and the attention to detail. 

     

    Welocalize helps the world's leading brands speak to a global audience — and language testing sits at the heart of that. You'll work alongside an experienced linguist and tester on technology most people won't see for months, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously. 

    If you're a native-level Bengali speaker with an eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology meet, we'd like to hear from you.

    About Welocalize 

    Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
     
    Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com 

    Job Responsibilities:

    This role involves managing translation and copy-editing tasks, ensuring high-quality linguistic deliverables for assigned projects or accounts. Responsibilities include coordinating with freelancers and agencies, maintaining language resources, resolving terminology queries, and collaborating with clients and internal teams to enhance workflow efficiency. #LI-JC1

    The following is a non-exhaustive list of responsibilities and areas of ownership for this role:

    • Performing copy-edit tasks on assigned projects or accounts
    • Performing on-demand translation tasks
    • Performing lead support on assigned projects or accounts
    • Managing and maintaining the language materials (including glossaries, Style Guides, work instruction) up to the quality standards and up to date as required by the account or project
    • Managing project-related queries
    • Ensuring good interaction among team members and resolving questions on terminology and language matters
    • Testing and qualifying new freelancers and vendors as required
    • Developing and training of internal linguists and external partners according to the accounts’ and Welocalize’s needs
    • Interacting with clients on linguistic matters as required
    • Participating in the development of new and improved working processes
    • Meet or exceed the KPIs in terms of productivity, on time delivery, quality
    • Achieving the goals set by the team manager

     

    Additional Job Details:

    REQUIREMENTS

    Education Level 

    • University degree in Translation/Applied Languages/Linguistic Studies or equivalent combination of education and experience (University degree in other fields plus 2 years of full time experience in translation; OR 5 years of full time professional experience in translating)

    Experience 

    • Native level fluency in Chinese
    • Fluency in English, both written and spoken, in a variety of registers
    • 4+ years of experience in translation/localization/editing or content writing
    • 2+ years of review experience
    • Thorough understanding of the localization process
    • Good user experience of standard software, such as Windows and Office applications
    • Good user experience of standard CAT tools, e.g. XTM, SDL Studio and issue tracking and query management tools, e.g. JIRA
    • Ability to learn new localization tools and applications quickly
    • Excellent interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills
    • Excellent knowledge of terminology used in two or more subject matters
    • Ability to work with tight deadlines
    • Ability to give clear, concise and constructive feedback
    • Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, linguists
    • Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
    • Ability and willingness to train/teach others and pass on knowledge
    • Ability, willingness and experience in communicating positively with customers at various levels
    • Ability to work within a virtual team

    About Welocalize 

    Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
     
    Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises.     ROLE OVERVIEW
     
    We are looking for a Croatian Linguistic Lead Tester to join a long-term project in Austin, Texas.
     
    As a Linguistic Lead Tester, you’ll help bring high-quality Croatian content to life and ensure it feels natural, accurate, and polished for end users. The Onsite Lead Tester is responsible for the overall quality of their language at an account level, as well as the main point of contact for Language Leads.
     
    This role is ideal for someone with native-level fluency in Croatian, fluency in English, and strong communication skills.
     
    We’re looking for someone who is comfortable working with customers and stakeholders at different levels, can provide clear, concise, and constructive feedback, and confidently present information and respond to questions from managers, clients, customers, and linguists.
     
    The ideal candidate also enjoys supporting and training others, sharing knowledge, and helping the team grow, and is available to work full-time.
     
     
    MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES
    • Managing linguistic tasks
    • Coordination of the linguistic team
    • Reviewing copies and giving feedback to testers
    • Sharing feedback received from the client
    • Supporting testers in understanding corrections resulting from the arbitration process
    • Acting as liaison for terminology, style issues, product features and questions
    • Supporting the onboarding process of new testers
    • Identifying linguistic-specific training needs for the language
    • Creating, maintaining, and delivering linguistic training programs
    • Quality management planning and execution
    • Client engagement
    • Linguistic assets management
    • Completing assigned tasks in a quality and timely manner.
     
    REQUIREMENTS
     
    • Onsite in our offices in Austin, TX.

    Overview 

    We are hiring Quality Control (QC) evaluators for a project that spans both Search and Linguistic tasks. You will perform quality checks on initial ratings produced by evaluators—validating user intent assessment, query annotation, text classification, and multimedia (video, image, audio) reviews for relevanc, accuracy, and guideline adherence. The ideal candidate combines strong language skills with sharp analytical judgment, excellent documentation and feedback skills, and familiarity with short-form video culture.

    ","id":"92e9560f-6079-4d00-b5df-9cc8dcf3885e","lists":[{"text":"What you will do","content":"
  • Audit samples of initial ratings for relevance, intent alignment, taxonomy compliance, and linguistic quality.
  • Re-rate items (double-scoring) to verify labels; resolve discrepancies and document decisions.
  • Perform linguistic quality checks (grammar, tone, clarity, local relevance) and media comprehension reviews.
  • Classify and track errors using an agreed error taxonomy; surface trends and edge cases.
  • Provide clear, actionable feedback to evaluators; contribute to guideline clarifications and updates.
  • Participate in and lead calibration sessions to drive inter-rater agreement.

About the Project 

Project Hydrus is a scripted and conversational audio data collection project. We're looking for native-level speakers who can deliver natural, everyday-sounding speech — recordings that hold up whether you're reading a script or speaking spontaneously. 

Please note: the recordings you produce may be used to create synthesized, AI-generated voices for conversational AI products. Full details on how your data is collected, used, shared, and retained are set out in a Consent Form, which you'll review and sign before any paid session recording begins. 

What You'll Do If Selected: 

  • Two supervised sessions of approximately 4 hours each, guided in real time by a Session Director on a separate recording platform. 

  • Record scripted material in a natural, conversational tone — faithfully, without a polished, performed, or “announcer” delivery. 

  • Record unscripted, spontaneous speech on a given topic, matching the same warmth and pace as your scripted takes. 

  • Set up and manage your own recording space and equipment for session recording. 

  • Deliver all recordings entirely in the required language (with specific dialect), without code-switching into other languages or dialects. 

What We're Looking For 

Required 

  • Experience as a voice actor, actor, or theater performer, or a comparable performance background. 

  • Native or native-equivalent fluency in the required language (with specific dialect). 

  • Access to a quiet recording space, free of echo and background noise (acoustically treated for session recording, if selected). 

  • Owns or will acquire a dedicated, professional-grade microphone for the audition (e.g. RODE NT-USB Mini, Blue Yeti), upgrading to a qualifying USB condenser or XLR mic + audio interface for session recording if selected. Built-in laptop mics, AirPods, earbuds, and headsets are not accepted at any stage. 

  • Owns closed-back monitoring headphones (required for session recording if selected). 

  • Comfortable both self-directing for the audition and taking live direction from a Session Director in guided sessions. 

Preferred (nice to have, not required) 

  • Professional voice-over experience (dubbing/ADR, audiobook, podcasting) in a conversational rather than commercial/announcer register. 

  • Baseline audio hygiene: comfortable setting mic distance and catching noise, clipping, or distortion yourself. 

  • An existing home recording setup already treated for sound. 

Your Data & Privacy 

Before any session recording, you'll be asked to review and sign a Consent Form covering how your voice recordings are collected, used (including to train synthesized/AI voice models), shared with approved partners, retained, and how to exercise your data rights (access, correction, deletion, and more, depending on where you live). If you'd like to review these terms before applying, contact us and we'll share a copy in advance.

About Welocalize 

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
 
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com 

ROLE OVERVIEW 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Indonesian speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programme for a major global technology and communications client. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Indonesian speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how it performs on a real device. You'll be among the first people to see this technology in Indonesian, and your judgement shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it. 

If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

 

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Review pre-release AI model output in Indonesian and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material. 

  • Test the Indonesian experience against the English one: confirm feature parity, complete a full user journey using non-English input, and check the product handles non-Latin script, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input correctly. 

  • Spot any display problem (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering badly) and any localization error — a wrong date, number, currency, unit, or a string left untranslated. 

  • Write up each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it: the step taken, the device and operating system, the locale, the build ID, and supporting evidence. Re-test once a fix lands to confirm it's resolved. 

  • Share your perspective as a native-level speaker on navigation, usability, and the language-specific nuance only a fluent speaker would catch. 

  • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office. Because of the confidential, pre-release nature of the technology, a remote or work-from-home arrangement isn't possible for this programme. 

  • Support other linguistic projects as needed. 

 

JOB REQUIREMENTS  

  • Native-level or fully bilingual Indonesian, written and spoken, with a current feel for how the language is really used day-to-day — every day and technical. 

  • Confidence with a smartphone and a laptop, and comfort moving between iOS and Android. 

  • A sharp eye for detail and fair, objective judgement when assessing quality. 

  • The ability to work independently, follow a detailed test script and guideline, and explain an issue clearly in English. 

  • Previous experience in software or app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus — though not essential if you bring the language skill and the attention to detail. 

 

Welocalize helps the world's leading brands speak to a global audience — and language testing sits at the heart of that. You'll work alongside an experienced linguist and tester on technology most people won't see for months, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously. 

If you're a native-level Indonesian speaker with an eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology meet, we'd like to hear from you.

About Welo Global 

Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages. The company combines globally scaled multilingual infrastructure, including a network of over 500,000 linguists and domain experts, with advanced NLP, computational linguistics, and best-in-class compliance backed by seven ISO certifications. Welo Global’s five brands—Welocalize (multilingual content and localization services for global enterprises), Park IP (intellectual property and patent translation services for law firms and corporate legal teams), Welo Life Sciences (regulated language and compliance-aligned content solutions for pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device organizations), Adapt (multilingual performance-led digital marketing agency), and Welo Data (multilingual data generation, evaluation, and human data infrastructure for AI systems)—serve distinct customer segments with purpose-built expertise, fit-for-purpose solutions, and supporting technology. weloglobal.com  


Job Overview

Ready to shape how people learn in the age of AI? We’re looking for an experienced Instructional Designer to join our L&D team and help us create learning with Sana, our AI-powered content development tool.

You’ll combine instructional expertise with AI fluency to turn expert knowledge and existing materials into clear, interactive, scalable learning experiences. AI handles much of the manual production. You guide it, direct it, and make sure everything that reaches our learners is accurate, purposeful, and on standard.

This role is based in India, and you’ll collaborate daily with colleagues across locations and time zones.

Main Responsibilities

Design learning with AI

  • Create courses and learning experiences in Sana, using it to draft outlines, learning objectives, lesson content, summaries, and assessments
  • Turn existing materials, such as slide decks, PDFs, SOPs, and technical documentation, into engaging interactive learning
  • Write effective prompts and instructions, and refine AI outputs until they meet instructional, technical, and brand standards
  • Use AI to adapt content for different roles, regions, and languages, and keep it current as processes and client requirements change
  • Explore new AI capabilities, share what works with the team, and help shape our standards for AI-enabled content development

Apply human expertise where it matters most

  • Partner with subject matter experts to identify business, client, and learner needs, and to validate content before it’s published
  • Review all AI-generated content for technical accuracy, tone, quality, and compliance with in-house standards and client guidelines. You are the final quality checkpoint
  • Translate complex technical information into clear language while keeping it accurate
  • Set clear instructional goals and make sure every piece of content helps learners achieve them

Build, measure, and improve

  • Develop learning content that meets our LMS requirements, including SCORM packages where needed
  • Design assessments and use learner data and feedback to improve both the content and the learner experience
  • Create supporting media (audio, visuals, simulations) that strengthen learning, using AI-assisted tools where appropriate
  • Work with operational leaders to support the ongoing monitoring and mentoring of learners

Collaborate and scale

  • Work with cross-functional teams across remote and office-based locations
  • Follow our processes, templates, and SOPs, and keep learning programs adaptable and scalable

Job Requirements

  • 5 years of experience in instructional design or learning content development
  • Hands-on experience using generative AI in content development, including prompting, iterating, and critically evaluating outputs
  • A responsible approach to AI: you understand its limits and rigorously review its output for accuracy, bias, and quality
  • In-depth knowledge of learning theories and instructional design models
  • Lesson and curriculum planning skills

Education Skills and Experience

Education

  • A bachelor’s degree is a plus, provided you have relevant experience and/or training
  • A master’s degree in instructional design, educational technology, or a related field is valued

Skills

  • Strong writing across instructional text, copy, and audio and video scripts
  • Effective verbal and written communication, with strong interpersonal and presentation skills, including the ability to work well in a remote setting
  • Strong computer skills
  • Positive, collaborative, and optimistic: you share ideas freely and see AI and change as opportunities
  • Self-driven and adaptable: you take initiative and are comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-evolving field
  • Commercially aware: you communicate confidently with commercial colleagues, negotiate well, and read a situation accurately

Experience

  • Experience with Sana or Workday Learning. Experience with other AI-native or AI-assisted authoring platforms is equally welcome, and we’ll support you in getting up to speed
  • Experience with traditional authoring tools (Articulate, Captivate, Lectora) and designing SCORM packages
  • Experience creating learning content for multilingual or global audiences
  • Design, video editing, and basic HTML skills
Join us and turn great knowledge into learning that people actually want to complete. With AI as your partner and your expertise as the guide, you’ll help create learning experiences that are clear, engaging, and built to make a real difference in how our people grow

  • Create supporting media (audio, visuals, simulations) that strengthen learning, using AI-assisted tools where appropriate
  • Work with operational leaders to support the ongoing monitoring and mentoring of learners

Collaborate and scale

  • Work with cross-functional teams across remote and office-based locations
  • Follow our processes, templates, and SOPs, and keep learning programs adaptable and scalable

Job Requirements

  • 5 years of experience in instructional design or learning content development
  • Hands-on experience using generative AI in content development, including prompting, iterating, and critically evaluating outputs
  • A responsible approach to AI: you understand its limits and rigorously review its output for accuracy, bias, and quality
  • In-depth knowledge of learning theories and instructional design models
  • Lesson and curriculum planning skills

Education Skills and Experience

Education

  • A bachelor’s degree is a plus, provided you have relevant experience and/or training
  • A master’s degree in instructional design, educational technology, or a related field is valued

Skills

  • Strong writing across instructional text, copy, and audio and video scripts
  • Effective verbal and written communication, with strong interpersonal and presentation skills, including the ability to work well in a remote setting
  • Strong computer skills
  • Positive, collaborative, and optimistic: you share ideas freely and see AI and change as opportunities
  • Self-driven and adaptable: you take initiative and are comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-evolving field
  • Commercially aware: you communicate confidently with commercial colleagues, negotiate well, and read a situation accurately

Experience

  • Experience with Sana or Workday Learning. Experience with other AI-native or AI-assisted authoring platforms is equally welcome, and we’ll support you in getting up to speed
  • Experience with traditional authoring tools (Articulate, Captivate, Lectora) and designing SCORM packages
  • Experience creating learning content for multilingual or global audiences
  • Design, video editing, and basic HTML skills
