    ROLE OVERVIEW

    The Software Development Engineer plays a pivotal role in the development of advanced information systems by deeply understanding business operations and translating them into scalable, maintainable, and efficient software solutions. This position requires a combination of technical expertise, creativity, and a collaborative approach to ensure that software components meet both current business needs and future growth. By analyzing operational requirements, the Software Development Engineer will design and implement complex software components, focusing on quality, performance, and long-term system sustainability.

    In this role, the Software Development Engineer works closely with cross-functional teams, including product management, quality assurance, and technical leads, to ensure the seamless integration of solutions across different systems. They are responsible for guiding the development process from concept to implementation, ensuring that software meets rigorous standards for security, reliability, and scalability. Additionally, they actively participate in code reviews, mentor junior engineers, and foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement within the development team.

    This position requires a strategic thinker with a passion for technology, someone who can balance hands-on coding with architectural oversight and technical leadership. Through their expertise and proactive problem-solving, the Software Engineer will contribute to the success of the team while working with SQL (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and the overall organization by delivering high-quality software that drives business results.

    MAIN DUTIES

    • Design and develop scalable applications focusing on high availability, fault tolerance, and performance optimization, while collaborating with DevOps teams to ensure smooth deployment and continuous delivery.
    • Implement and maintain RESTful APIs while working with SQL (MySQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB), with expertise in writing and optimizing complex queries.
    • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to software engineers, ensuring adherence to best practices and architectural standards.
    • Collaborate with stakeholders to analyze requirements, troubleshoot issues, and deliver high-quality solutions aligned with business objectives.
    • Demonstrate expertise in system design, architecture, and optimization of complex systems, ensuring scalability and maintainability.
    • Quickly understand and adapt to existing system design and architecture to drive solutions that integrate seamlessly within established frameworks.
    • Optimize and fine-tune existing solutions for enhanced performance and operational efficiency.
    • Provide robust solutions for complex XML parsing and integrating third-party systems into the application ecosystem.
    • Architect systems using strong system design principles, incorporating security best practices, and demonstrating proficiency in OAuth 2.0 for authentication and authorization.
    • Leverage domain expertise in localization to deliver tailored solutions that meet industry-specific requirements.
    • Foster effective cross-team communication to align technical strategies with business goals and ensure smooth collaboration across departments.
    • Proven experience in full-stack development, with a deep understanding of front-end, back-end, and cloud technologies.

    REQUIREMENTS

    Education Level

    Post-secondary degree in Computer Science or equivalent professional experience.

    Experience

    • Demonstrable professional experience as the technical owner of major components or subsystems through the software development lifecycle.
    • Hands-on knowledge of AI-assisted coding tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar) and a good understanding of prompt engineering, token optimization, and efficient token usage to improve development productivity and code quality.
    • Previous professional experience collaborating with business stakeholders.
    • Experience shipping code in an agile SDLC.
    • Previous experience in performance analysis and benchmarking.
    • Able to apply continuous integration, development, and automated testing concepts.
    • Knowledge of multiple frameworks, paradigms, languages, and trends in the relevant domain. 

    Technical Skills

    • Programming & Frameworks: Expertise in JavaScript, NodeJS, React, Vue.js, Go, Python.
    • Should be technology-agnostic, adaptable to different technology stacks, programming languages, frameworks, and tools.
    • Cloud & DevOps: Expertise in AWS, Azure, Docker,  Git, CI/CD Pipelines. 
    • Databases: Expertise in MySQL, MongoDB, in database design, optimization, and complex queries.
    • Testing & Monitoring: JUnit, Mockito, Postman, JMeter, Dynatrace, New Relic.
    • Architectural Patterns: Expertise in Microservices, RESTful Services, and Integration Architecture.
    • Soft Skills: Strong problem-solving, collaboration, and communication
    • Microservices & Architecture: Expertise in microservices design, deployment, and orchestration
    • Security: Security: OAuth, JWT, SAST, DAST, OWASP Top 10 
    • Version Control: Expertise in managing complex version control scenarios
    • API Documentation: Expertise in API documentation and automation
    • Project Management Tools: Expertise in project tracking and collaboration with Confluence.

    Join our team and contribute to creating cutting-edge solutions that support the future growth and success of Welocalize. If you’re ready to take on this challenge and help us build the next generation of technology, we encourage you to apply today.

    About Welo Life Sciences 

    Welo Life Sciences, a Welo Global brand, is a specialized language and technology partner serving pharmaceutical, CRO, and medical device organizations operating in regulated global markets. We deliver regulator-ready translation, linguistic validation, and localization solutions that support clinical trials, pharmacovigilance, regulatory affairs, labeling, and global commercialization. Our approach combines subject matter expertise with ISO-certified quality processes and technology-enabled workflows designed to integrate seamlessly into life sciences operations. With extensive experience supporting global product development and post-market requirements, Welo Life Sciences helps organizations accelerate timelines, protect data integrity, and maintain compliance across languages and regions. All solutions are delivered within a secure, audit-ready framework supported by seven ISO certifications.  welolifesciences.com

    About the Role

    We are looking for experienced Spanish (Spain) to English (GB or US) linguists to support a high-volume, fast-turnaround pharmacovigilance program for a leading global pharmaceutical company. Work involves translating and reviewing safety and regulatory content, including adverse event reports and related clinical documentation, with strict turnaround times and deadlines. 

    This is an ongoing freelance engagement with daily volumes.

    Key Responsibilities

    • Translate Pharmacovigilance and/or Clinical-regulatory content from Spanish into English.
    • Perform Machine Translation Post-Editing (MTPE) on machine-translated safety content.
    • Perform Copy Edit review of translated/post-edited content for accuracy, tone, and consistency.
    • Meet strict, non-extendable turnaround times on time-sensitive safety content.

    Requirements

    • Degree in translation, linguistics or languages studies or an equivalent degree that includes significant 
      translation training.
    • Minimum 2 years of professional experience translating medical documentation, specificially with experience and knowledge in Pharmacovigilance and/or Clinical-Regulatory content.
    • Experience translating pharmacovigilance content preferred: SAE/AE (serious and non-serious adverse events), PSURs, SUSARs, ICSRs, DSURs, Risk Management Plans (RMP).
    • Alternatively, experience translating regulatory or clinical documents: medical reports, protocols, synopses, ICF, discharge reports, study reports, SmPC, PIL, or medical literature.
    • Great daily availability: this program requires consistent daily capacity and is not suited to part-time schedules.
    • Strong Spanish proficiency; native level of English preferred but not mandatory.
    • Experience with XTM or similar CAT tools.
    • Reliable, deadline-driven, and flexible, able to commit to fast turnaround times with no extensions.

    Nice to Have

    • Healthcare professional (HCP) background: nurse or physician preferred, especially with emergency room experience. Other HCP backgrounds also welcome.
    • Willingness to commit to daily and/or weekend availability.

    Tools & Systems

    • CAT tool: XTM, client-provided license; onboarding and connector setup provided after onboarding.

    Before Applying

    Please note there will be an assessment as part of our onboarding and quality procedure, please only apply if you're willing to complete our assessment.
     
    Please ensure your latest English CV accurately reflects your Life Sciences and Medical translation experience, including years of experience specifically in Life Sciences, the document types you’ve translated, CAT tool you've used, and relevant details also your contact information (email AND phone number).

    We look forward to receiving your application!

    MAIN PUROPOSE OF JOB
     
    The Spanish Patent Language Lead is a critical position that requires a strong background in translation, localization, and copy-editing tasks with a focus on patent/legal documents. This professional is responsible for translating, copy editing or reviewing complex patent/legal materials from English into Spanish, ensuring the highest quality and accuracy of the deliverables to client. This role works closely with Quality, Program Squads, Talent, vendors and other stakeholders to provide precise language support for patent-related matters. 
     
    This professional ensures that the expected level of translation quality is maintained, and the product delivered to the client should always meet its intended purpose, while closely monitoring that translation expenses remain within budget. The position also supports broader team efforts through editing, error arbitration, and active participation in quality initiatives. 
     
    The Spanish Patent Language Lead understands legal requirements and engages the production team in the fulfillment of these requirements, crafting client solutions based on the Welo Global Four Pillars of Customer Service, Quality, Innovation and Global Teamwork.  
    ","id":"3c0ba4b4-1422-4ff0-95e8-8c80335d22da","lists":[{"text":"MAIN RESPONSABILITIES","content":"
    The following is a non-exhaustive list of responsibilities and areas of ownership for this role:

  • Performing copy-edit tasks on assigned projects or accounts

  • Performing on-demand translation tasks

  • Performing lead linguist role on assigned accounts

  • Taking ownership of deliveries that were translated internally or by external partners for one or more accounts into their target language

  • Preparing, managing and maintaining the language materials (including glossaries, Style Guides, work instruction) up to the quality standards and up to date as required by the account or project

  • Managing project-related queries

  • Ensuring good interaction among team members and resolving questions on terminology and language matters

  • Coordinating with freelancers, agencies and internal linguists on assigned projects or accounts

  • Testing and qualifying new freelancers and vendors as required

    About Welocalize 

    Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
     
    Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com 

    ROLE OVERVIEW 

    Welocalize is looking for a native-level Tamil speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programme for a major global technology and communications client. 

    It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

    Welocalize is looking for a native-level Tamil speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme. 

    It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how it performs on a real device. You'll be among the first people to see this technology in Tamil , and your judgement shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it. 

    If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

     

    MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 

    • Review pre-release AI model output in Tamil and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material. 

    • Test the Tamil experience against the English one: confirm feature parity, complete a full user journey using non-English input, and check the product handles non-Latin script, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input correctly. 

    • Spot any display problem (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering badly) and any localization error — a wrong date, number, currency, unit, or a string left untranslated. 

    • Write up each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it: the step taken, the device and operating system, the locale, the build ID, and supporting evidence. Re-test once a fix lands to confirm it's resolved. 

    • Share your perspective as a native-level speaker on navigation, usability, and the language-specific nuance only a fluent speaker would catch. 

    • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office. Because of the confidential, pre-release nature of the technology, a remote or work-from-home arrangement isn't possible for this programme. 

    • Support other linguistic projects as needed. 

     

    JOB REQUIREMENTS  

    • Native-level or fully bilingual Tamil , written and spoken, with a current feel for how the language is really used day-to-day — every day and technical. 

    • Confidence with a smartphone and a laptop, and comfort moving between iOS and Android. 

    • A sharp eye for detail and fair, objective judgement when assessing quality. 

    • The ability to work independently, follow a detailed test script and guideline, and explain an issue clearly in English. 

    • Previous experience in software or app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus — though not essential if you bring the language skill and the attention to detail. 

     

    Welocalize helps the world's leading brands speak to a global audience — and language testing sits at the heart of that. You'll work alongside an experienced linguist and tester on technology most people won't see for months, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously. 

    If you're a native-level Tamil speaker with an eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology meet, we'd like to hear from you.

    About Welocalize 

    Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
     
    Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com 

    ROLE OVERVIEW 

    Welocalize is looking for a native-level Telugu speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programme for a major global technology and communications client. 

    It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

    Welocalize is looking for a native-level Telugu speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme. 

    It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how it performs on a real device. You'll be among the first people to see this technology in Telugu, and your judgement shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it. 

    If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

     

    MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 

    • Review pre-release AI model output in Telugu and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material. 

    • Test the Telugu experience against the English one: confirm feature parity, complete a full user journey using non-English input, and check the product handles non-Latin script, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input correctly. 

    • Spot any display problem (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering badly) and any localization error — a wrong date, number, currency, unit, or a string left untranslated. 

    • Write up each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it: the step taken, the device and operating system, the locale, the build ID, and supporting evidence. Re-test once a fix lands to confirm it's resolved. 

    • Share your perspective as a native-level speaker on navigation, usability, and the language-specific nuance only a fluent speaker would catch. 

    • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office. Because of the confidential, pre-release nature of the technology, a remote or work-from-home arrangement isn't possible for this programme. 

    • Support other linguistic projects as needed. 

     

    JOB REQUIREMENTS  

    • Native-level or fully bilingual Telugu, written and spoken, with a current feel for how the language is really used day-to-day — every day and technical. 

    • Confidence with a smartphone and a laptop, and comfort moving between iOS and Android. 

    • A sharp eye for detail and fair, objective judgement when assessing quality. 

    • The ability to work independently, follow a detailed test script and guideline, and explain an issue clearly in English. 

    • Previous experience in software or app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus — though not essential if you bring the language skill and the attention to detail. 

     

    Welocalize helps the world's leading brands speak to a global audience — and language testing sits at the heart of that. You'll work alongside an experienced linguist and tester on technology most people won't see for months, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously. 

    If you're a native-level Telugu speaker with an eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology meet, we'd like to hear from you.

You'll be among the first people to see this technology in Traditional Chinese, and your judgement shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it. 

    If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

     

    MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 

    • Review pre-release AI model output in Traditional Chinese and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material. 

    • Test the Traditional Chinese experience against the English one: confirm feature parity, complete a full user journey using non-English input, and check the product handles non-Latin script, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input correctly. 

    • Spot any display problem (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering badly) and any localization error — a wrong date, number, currency, unit, or a string left untranslated. 

    • Write up each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it: the step taken, the device and operating system, the locale, the build ID, and supporting evidence. Re-test once a fix lands to confirm it's resolved. 

    • Share your perspective as a native-level speaker on navigation, usability, and the language-specific nuance only a fluent speaker would catch. 

    • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office. Because of the confidential, pre-release nature of the technology, a remote or work-from-home arrangement isn't possible for this programme. 

    • Support other linguistic projects as needed. 

     

    JOB REQUIREMENTS  

    • Native-level or fully bilingual Traditional Chinese, written and spoken, with a current feel for how the language is really used day-to-day — every day and technical. 

    • Confidence with a smartphone and a laptop, and comfort moving between iOS and Android. 

    • A sharp eye for detail and fair, objective judgement when assessing quality. 

    • The ability to work independently, follow a detailed test script and guideline, and explain an issue clearly in English. 

    • Previous experience in software or app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus — though not essential if you bring the language skill and the attention to detail. 

     

    Welocalize helps the world's leading brands speak to a global audience — and language testing sits at the heart of that. You'll work alongside an experienced linguist and tester on technology most people won't see for months, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously. 

    If you're a native-level Traditional Chinese speaker with an eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology meet, we'd like to hear from you.

    About Welocalize 

    Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
     
    Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com 

    ROLE OVERVIEW 

    Welocalize is looking for a native-level Urdu (Romanized) speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programme for a major global technology and communications client. 

    It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

    Welocalize is looking for a native-level Urdu (Romanized) speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme. 

    It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how it performs on a real device. You'll be among the first people to see this technology in Urdu (Romanized), and your judgement shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it. 

    If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

     

    MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 

    • Review pre-release AI model output in Urdu (Romanized) and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material. 

    • Test the Urdu (Romanized) experience against the English one: confirm feature parity, complete a full user journey using non-English input, and check the product handles non-Latin script, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input correctly. 

    • Spot any display problem (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering badly) and any localization error — a wrong date, number, currency, unit, or a string left untranslated. 

    • Write up each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it: the step taken, the device and operating system, the locale, the build ID, and supporting evidence. Re-test once a fix lands to confirm it's resolved. 

    • Share your perspective as a native-level speaker on navigation, usability, and the language-specific nuance only a fluent speaker would catch. 

    • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office. Because of the confidential, pre-release nature of the technology, a remote or work-from-home arrangement isn't possible for this programme. 

    • Support other linguistic projects as needed. 

     

    JOB REQUIREMENTS  

    • Native-level or fully bilingual Urdu (Romanized), written and spoken, with a current feel for how the language is really used day-to-day — every day and technical. 

    • Confidence with a smartphone and a laptop, and comfort moving between iOS and Android. 

    • A sharp eye for detail and fair, objective judgement when assessing quality. 

    • The ability to work independently, follow a detailed test script and guideline, and explain an issue clearly in English. 

    • Previous experience in software or app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus — though not essential if you bring the language skill and the attention to detail. 

     

    Welocalize helps the world's leading brands speak to a global audience — and language testing sits at the heart of that. You'll work alongside an experienced linguist and tester on technology most people won't see for months, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously. 

    If you're a native-level Urdu (Romanized) speaker with an eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology meet, we'd like to hear from you.

    ROLE OVERVIEW 

    Welocalize is looking for a native-level Vietnamese speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programme for a major global technology and communications client. 

    It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

    Welocalize is looking for a native-level Vietnamese speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme. 

    It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how it performs on a real device. You'll be among the first people to see this technology in Vietnamese, and your judgement shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it. 

    If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

     

    MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 

    • Review pre-release AI model output in Vietnamese and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material. 

    • Test the Vietnamese experience against the English one: confirm feature parity, complete a full user journey using non-English input, and check the product handles non-Latin script, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input correctly. 

    • Spot any display problem (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering badly) and any localization error — a wrong date, number, currency, unit, or a string left untranslated. 

    • Write up each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it: the step taken, the device and operating system, the locale, the build ID, and supporting evidence. Re-test once a fix lands to confirm it's resolved. 

    • Share your perspective as a native-level speaker on navigation, usability, and the language-specific nuance only a fluent speaker would catch. 

    • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office. Because of the confidential, pre-release nature of the technology, a remote or work-from-home arrangement isn't possible for this programme. 

    • Support other linguistic projects as needed. 

     

    JOB REQUIREMENTS  

    • Native-level or fully bilingual Vietnamese, written and spoken, with a current feel for how the language is really used day-to-day — every day and technical. 

    • Confidence with a smartphone and a laptop, and comfort moving between iOS and Android. 

    • A sharp eye for detail and fair, objective judgement when assessing quality. 

    • The ability to work independently, follow a detailed test script and guideline, and explain an issue clearly in English. 

    • Previous experience in software or app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus — though not essential if you bring the language skill and the attention to detail. 

     

    Welocalize helps the world's leading brands speak to a global audience — and language testing sits at the heart of that. You'll work alongside an experienced linguist and tester on technology most people won't see for months, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously. 

    If you're a native-level Vietnamese speaker with an eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology meet, we'd like to hear from you.

    募集の背景

    Welo Dataは日本で博士レベルの専門家の人材パイプラインを構築し、主要なAIクライアントとの将来的なプロジェクトを見越しています。これは明日から始まるプロジェクトではありませんが、数ヶ月後に始まる予定のプロジェクトに備え、最終決定次第、専門家と事前に連絡を取りたいと考えています。今すぐ登録することで、プロジェクトの開始時に優先的に作業の指導を受けることができます。

    採用要件

    私たちは表面的な知識ではなく、真の専門知識を持つ人を求めています。

    以下のいずれかの分野で博士号(ABD)を取得した、または取得予定の応募者:

    • 社会科学・行動科学 (心理学、社会学、人類学、政治学、経済学など)
    • 人文科学 (歴史、哲学、宗教学、地域研究など)
    • 芸術 (美術史、パフォーマンス研究、音楽、メディア・文化研究など)
    • 言語学 (日本語、翻訳研究、応用言語学、文学など)
    • ネイティブまたはビジネスレベルの日本語能力
    • 優れた文章力 — 複雑な概念を明確に説明できる能力
    • リモート環境で自律的に働き、締め切りを守り、自律的に進める個人

    事業概要(仮定)

    プロジェクトが最終決定された後、選ばれた専門家には以下の任務が割り当てられることが期待されます。

    • あなたの専門分野におけるAI応答の作成、レビュー、評価
    • AI出力の正確性、論理性、ニュアンスの評価
    • モデル品質の向上につながる構造的フィードバックの提供
    • 博士レベルの判断を専門分野の実務問題に応用する

    今すぐ登録することの利点

    • 将来のプロジェクトの優先指針
    • 研究者や学者に適した柔軟でリモートのプロジェクトベースの勤務スタイル
    • AIシステム構築に直接専門知識を活かす機会です

    Welo Dataは日本で博士レベルの専門家の人材パイプラインを構築し、主要なAIクライアントとの将来的なプロジェクトを見越しています。これは明日から始まるプロジェクトではありませんが、数ヶ月後に始まる予定のプロジェクトに備え、最終決定次第、専門家と事前に連絡を取りたいと考えています。今すぐ登録することで、プロジェクトの開始時に優先的に作業の指導を受けることができます。

    採用要件

    私たちは表面的な知識ではなく、真の専門知識を持つ人を求めています。

    以下のいずれかの分野で博士号(ABD)を取得した、または取得予定の応募者:

    • 社会科学・行動科学 (心理学、社会学、人類学、政治学、経済学など)
    • 人文科学 (歴史、哲学、宗教学、地域研究など)
    • 芸術 (美術史、パフォーマンス研究、音楽、メディア・文化研究など)
    • 言語学 (日本語、翻訳研究、応用言語学、文学など)
    • ネイティブまたはビジネスレベルの日本語能力
    • 優れた文章力 — 複雑な概念を明確に説明できる能力
    • リモート環境で自律的に働き、締め切りを守り、自律的に進める個人

    事業概要(仮定)

    プロジェクトが最終決定された後、選ばれた専門家には以下の任務が割り当てられることが期待されます。

    • あなたの専門分野におけるAI応答の作成、レビュー、評価
    • AI出力の正確性、論理性、ニュアンスの評価
    • モデル品質の向上につながる構造的フィードバックの提供
    • 博士レベルの判断を専門分野の実務問題に応用する

    今すぐ登録することの利点

    • 将来のプロジェクトの優先指針
    • 研究者や学者に適した柔軟でリモートのプロジェクトベースの勤務スタイル
    • AIシステム構築に直接専門知識を活かす機会です

    - Strong attention to detail and ability to follow detailed instructions
    - Dependable, communicative, and capable of meeting deadlines
    - General awareness of current events and cultural nuances in the Target Language region is a plus
    - Comfortable reviewing potentially sensitive or offensive content
     
    Benefits
    - 100% remote work
    - Flexible schedule
    - Supplemental income opportunity
    - Timely payments
    - Ideal for students, part-timers, or stay-at-home parents
     
     
    Please apply using a GMAIL account if you have one.

At Appen, we work with 8 out of the top 10 global technology companies in the world to improve and optimize their products for users worldwide, including social media platforms, search engines, voice recognition systems, and eCommerce sites. The world of tech is moving fast, and since our founding in 1996 we rose to the challenge by becoming a publicly listed company and by building an international team that works in over 130 countries and in more than 180 languages.

 

Do you love to surf the internet and want to influence how we interact with technology? As a Search Engine Evaluator with Appen you have the opportunity to provide feedback on news feeds, advertisements and search results. Your ideas have a direct impact on the services and content from social media and search platform sites that we use every single day.

 

You Might Fit This Role If:

• You are looking for a flexible work opportunity where you contribute to projects and grow your skills

• You are an active and engaged user on social media platforms such as Facebook and Instagram

• You enjoy working independently

• You want to do internet-based work from home

 

"},"jobDescription":{"title":"Job Description","text":"

Work Schedule:

• Search Engine Evaluator positions are part-time (up to 20 hours per week) and highly flexible

• The usual position requires 1-4 hours of work per day, 5-7 days a week

Minimum Qualifications:

• Currently living in and legally permitted to work in the United States

• Access to a computer with a sound card and speakers, and/ or access to a smart phone that is less than three years old

• Access to a secure high speed internet connection and quiet non-public workspace

• Good English writing skills (Bilingual communication skill is a plus!)

• Ability to work with applications, troubleshoot software, and execute instructions independently

"},"qualifications":{"title":"Qualifications","text":"

  • Chinese

      <description><p><span>We are currently looking for speakers of </span><strong>Gujarati </strong>to participate in a <strong>paid voice collection project</strong> <span>that will be used to improve voice recognition technologies for virtual assistants.</span></p><h3>Project Details</h3><p><span><strong>📌</strong></span><strong> What participants will do</strong></p><p>Participants will take part in a recorded conversation with another person while wearing earbuds. The discussion is guided with prompts and designed to feel natural and engaging, covering everyday topics such as hobbies, shopping, weather, or general opinions.</p><p><span><strong>👥</strong></span><strong> Join with a friend</strong></p><p>This study is conducted in pairs, so members are encouraged to sign up with a friend, classmate, or partner. This makes the experience more enjoyable and both participants, <strong>each</strong> will receive a compensation of <strong>$55 USD</strong> upon successful completion.       <title>Plumeria - Voice Message Collection Project - India</title>
      <description><p>DataForce by TransPerfect is looking for people living in India to share existing WhatsApp voice messages for a short, remote project. If you use voice messages to chat in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Gujarati, Marathi, Bengali, or Urdu, this could be a good fit for you. You don’t need to record anything new!</p><h4>Who is this for?</h4><p>You may qualify if you’re a native speaker of one of these languages and have <strong>12–15 minutes of voice messages you personally recorded and sent in a single WhatsApp conversation before November 12, 2026</strong>.</p><h4>What will you do?</h4><p>You will select one WhatsApp chat containing approximately 12–15 minutes of voice messages in your selected project language(s) that you personally recorded and sent, export it, and submit it through our DataForce Contribute app following the guidelines shared by our team.</p><p>Only existing voice messages sent <strong>before November 12, 2026</strong> are eligible. Newly recorded or scripted messages will not be accepted.</p><p>Only your own voice messages count toward the required audio. Messages containing personal information, unintelligible speech, or explicit content will not be accepted.</p><h4>Who can participate?</h4><p>To qualify, you must:</p><ul><li><p>Be a native speaker of Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Gujarati, Marathi, Bengali, or Urdu.</p></li><li><p>Currently live in India.</p></li><li><p>Have approximately 12–15 minutes of your own existing WhatsApp voice messages in one conversation in your selected project language.</p></li><li><p>Sign the participation consent form before submitting your messages.</p></li></ul><p>If you are a native speaker of more than one project language and have suitable voice messages in each, you can indicate this in a single application.</p><h4>Where is the project taking place?</h4><p>This is a fully <strong>remote</strong> project. You can participate from the comfort of your home.</p><h4>Workload</h4><p>The task is estimated to take approximately 30 minutes per language submission, including reviewing the guidelines, exporting the conversation, and uploading your submission.</p><p>All submissions will undergo quality review to confirm the speaker, language, recording dates, audio clarity, and absence of personal information in the accepted audio.</p><h4>Compensation</h4><p>Compensation is<strong> $12 USD for each accepted submission containing at least 10 minutes of approved audio per language.</strong></p><p>You will also receive a <strong>$3 USD completion bonus per accepted submission</strong> if you submit by the deadline specified in your project instructions email.</p><p><br>As payment method, we offer <strong>PayPal, Gift Card, and Wire Transfer</strong>, according to your preference.</p><p>Please note that our Quality Assurance team will review all submissions to ensure they meet the project specific requirements. The project team will provide you with feedback once the Quality Check process is completed.</p><h4>Questions or doubts?</h4><p>If you have any doubts or questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to us at: <a target="_blank" href="mailto:DataForce.Sourcing@transperfect.com">DataForce.Sourcing@transperfect.com</a></p><p>If you're interested in participating and meet the above qualifying criteria, please click Apply Here, and complete the registration form.</p></description>

/* Loader */
.animate-loader div {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  display: block;
  position: absolute;
  width: 64px;
  height: 64px;
  margin: 8px;
  border: 8px solid #ddd;
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: animate-loader 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.5, 0, 0.5, 1) infinite;
  border-color: #ddd transparent transparent transparent;
}
.animate-loader div:nth-child(1) {
  animation-delay: -0.45s;
}
.animate-loader div:nth-child(2) {
  animation-delay: -0.3s;
}
.animate-loader div:nth-child(3) {
  animation-delay: -0.15s;
}
@keyframes animate-loader {
  0% {
    transform: rotate(0deg);
  }
  100% {
    transform: rotate(360deg);
  }
}

/* tech loop */
.marquee_track {
  white-space: nowrap;
  will-change: transform;
  animation: marquee 35s linear infinite;
}

[data-track-visibility] .marquee_track {
  animation-play-state: paused;
}

.is-visible[data-track-visibility] .marquee_track {
  animation-play-state: running;
}

@keyframes marquee {
  from {
    transform: translateX(0);
  }
  to {
    transform: translateX(-50%);
  }
}

@keyframes marqueeAlt {
  from {
    transform: translateX(0);
  }
  to {
    transform: translateX(50%);
  }
}

/* trusted by loop */
.marquee_track.is-logos {
  white-space: nowrap;
  will-change: transform;
  animation: marquee 12.5s linear infinite paused;
}

/* language */

  will-change: transform;
  animation: marquee 40s linear infinite paused;

<script>
function moveElements() {
  const triggers = document.querySelectorAll('[data-move-element="trigger"]');

  triggers.forEach((trigger) => {
    const parent = trigger.parentElement;

    if (!parent) return;

    const target = parent.querySelector('[data-move-element="target"]');

    if (!target) return;

    target.appendChild(trigger);
  });
}

function trackAllImgsLoad() {
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-track-all-img-load]").forEach(async (parent) => {
      const images = [...parent.querySelectorAll("img")];

      await Promise.all(
        images.map(
          (img) =>
            new Promise((resolve) => {
              const onLoad = () => {
                img.classList.add("loaded");
                resolve();
              };

              if (img.complete) {
                onLoad();
              } else {
                img.addEventListener("load", onLoad, { once: true });
                img.addEventListener("error", onLoad, { once: true });
              }
            })
        )
      );

      parent.classList.add("loaded");
    });
};

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  moveElements();
  trackAllImgsLoad();
});
</script>

<script>
document.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
  const tabLink = event.target.closest(".b_m_link.w-tab-link");

  if (!tabLink || window.innerWidth < 992) return;

  setTimeout(function () {
    const activeTabPane = document.querySelector(
      ".w-tab-pane.w--tab-active"
    );

    if (!activeTabPane) return;

    const topOffset = 80;
    const paneTop = activeTabPane.getBoundingClientRect().top;

    // Do nothing when the pane's top is already visible
    if (paneTop >= topOffset && paneTop < window.innerHeight) return;

    window.scrollTo({
      top: window.scrollY + paneTop - topOffset,
      behavior: "smooth"
    });
  }, 100);
});
</script>
<script>
const state = {
  jobs: { result: [], count: 0 },
  keyword: "",
  pagination: { page: 1, limit: 18, loading: false },
  els: {
    wrapper: document.querySelector(".jobs_list"),
    formSearch: document.querySelector(".jobs_form_form"),
    inputSearch: document.querySelector(".jobs_form_search"),
    btnSearchSubmit: document.querySelector(".jobs_form_btn"),
    btnFormSubmit: document.querySelector("input[type='submit']"),
    formFilters: document.querySelector(".jobs_popup_form"),
  },
  trackingString: "",
  searchTimeout: null,
  observer: null,
};

async function initApp() {
  initSearch();
  initPopover();
  await updateJobs(true);
}

initApp();

async function updateJobs(checkParams = false) {
  const existingSentinel = document.querySelector(".scroll-sentinel");
  if (existingSentinel) existingSentinel.remove();

  if (state.observer) {
    state.observer.disconnect();
  }

  state.pagination.page = 1;
  state.pagination.loading = false;
  state.jobs.result = [];

  renderLoader();

  if (checkParams) {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const search = params.get("search");

    if (search) {
      state.els.inputSearch.value = search;
      state.keyword = search;
    }
  }

  try {
    await fetchJobs();

    if (!state.trackingString) setUTM();

    renderJobs();
    setupInfiniteScroll();
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error fetching jobs:", error);
    state.els.wrapper.innerHTML =
      "<p>Unable to load jobs. Please try again.</p>";
  }
}

function renderLoader() {
  state.els.wrapper.innerHTML = `
    <div class="jobs_loader-wrap">
      <div class="css-loader animate-loader">
        <div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
}

function renderMoreLoader() {
  if (document.querySelector(".jobs_loader-wrap")) return;

  state.els.wrapper.insertAdjacentHTML(
    "beforeend",
    `<div class="jobs_loader-wrap">
      <div class="css-loader animate-loader">
        <div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div>
      </div>
    </div>`
  );
}

async function fetchJobs() {
  const baseURL = window.location.href.includes("webflow.io")
    ? "https://dev-api.micro1.ai/api/v1"
    : "https://prod-api.micro1.ai/api/v1";

  const response = await fetch(
    `${baseURL}/job/portal?page=${state.pagination.page}&limit=${state.pagination.limit}&keyword=${encodeURIComponent(state.keyword)}`,
    {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        action: "get_all_jobs",
        filters: { type: ["EXPERT"] },
      }),
    }
  );

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Request failed: ${response.status}`);
  }

  const data = await response.json();
  state.jobs.count = Number(data.total) || 0;

  const newJobs = (data.data || []).slice(0, state.pagination.limit);

  if (state.pagination.page === 1) {
    state.jobs.result = newJobs;
  } else {
    state.jobs.result = [...state.jobs.result, ...newJobs];
  }

  console.log("Jobs loaded:", state.jobs.result.length);
}

function renderJobs() {
  state.els.wrapper.innerHTML = "";

  if (state.jobs.count === 0) {
    renderNoResults();
    return;
  }

  renderJobsHeader();
  renderJobsList();
}

function renderJobsHeader() {
  const clearButton = state.keyword
    ? `<span class="jobs_result-clear" clear-search>Clear search</span>`
    : "";

  state.els.wrapper.insertAdjacentHTML(
    "afterbegin",
    `<p class="jobs_result-info">${state.jobs.count} ${state.jobs.count === 1 ? "role" : "roles"} found ${clearButton}</p>`
  );

  listenerClearFilters();
}

function renderJobsList() {
  state.jobs.result.forEach((job) => {
    state.els.wrapper.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", createJobEl(job));
  });
}

function renderLoadMoreSentinel() {
  document.querySelector(".scroll-sentinel")?.remove();

  if (state.jobs.result.length < state.jobs.count) {
    state.els.wrapper.insertAdjacentHTML(
      "afterend",
      '<div class="scroll-sentinel"></div>'
    );

    const sentinel = document.querySelector(".scroll-sentinel");

    if (sentinel && state.observer) {
      state.observer.observe(sentinel);
    }
  }
}

function setupInfiniteScroll() {
  if (state.observer) state.observer.disconnect();

  state.observer = createIntersectionObserver();
  renderLoadMoreSentinel();
}

function createIntersectionObserver() {
  return new IntersectionObserver(
    async (entries) => {
      const entry = entries[0];

      if (
        entry.isIntersecting &&
        !state.pagination.loading &&
        state.jobs.result.length < state.jobs.count
      ) {
        state.observer.unobserve(entry.target);
        await loadMoreJobs();
      }
    },
    { rootMargin: "100px" }
  );
}

async function loadMoreJobs() {
  if (
    state.pagination.loading ||
    state.jobs.result.length >= state.jobs.count
  ) {
    return;
  }

  state.pagination.loading = true;
  renderMoreLoader();

  try {
    const previousLength = state.jobs.result.length;
    state.pagination.page += 1;

    await fetchJobs();

    document.querySelector(".jobs_loader-wrap")?.remove();

    const newJobs = state.jobs.result.slice(previousLength);

    newJobs.forEach((job) => {
      state.els.wrapper.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", createJobEl(job));
    });

    renderLoadMoreSentinel();
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error loading more jobs:", error);
    document.querySelector(".jobs_loader-wrap")?.remove();
  } finally {
    state.pagination.loading = false;
  }
}

function renderNoResults() {
  state.els.wrapper.insertAdjacentHTML(
    "afterbegin",
    `<div class="jobs_result-0-wrap">
      <div class="jobs_result-0-img"></div>
      <p>
        No roles match your search.
        <span class="job_result-0-clear" clear-search>Clear search</span>
      </p>
    </div>`
  );

  listenerClearFilters();
}

function createJobEl(job) {
  const tag = job.job_tags?.[0];

  const date = job.date_posted
    ? new Date(job.date_posted).toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
        year: "numeric",
        month: "short",
        day: "numeric",
      })
    : "";

  const allSkills = job.skills || [];
  const skills = allSkills.slice(0, 3);
  const link = job.apply_url ? formatLink(job.apply_url) : "";

  return `
    <a href="${link}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"
       class="jobs_item w-inline-block">
      <div class="jobs_hover"></div>

      <div class="jobs_top-wrap">
        <div class="jobs_info-wrap">
          <div class="jobs_date">${date}</div>
        </div>

        <h2 class="jobs_name">${job.job_name || ""}</h2>

        <div class="jobs_skills">
          ${skills.length ? "<div>Required skills</div>" : ""}
          <div class="jobs_skills-list">
            ${skills.map((skill) =>
              `<div class="jobs_skill-cap"><div>${skill}</div></div>`
            ).join("")}
            ${
              allSkills.length > 3
                ? `<div class="jobs_skill-cap"><div>${allSkills.length - 3}+</div></div>`
                : ""
            }
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="jobs_bottom">
        <div class="jobs_salary">
          ${
            job.ideal_hourly_rate || job.ideal_yearly_compensation
              ? salary(tag, job.ideal_hourly_rate, job.ideal_yearly_compensation)
              : ""
          }
        </div>

        <div class="jobs_cta">
          <div class="jobs_cta-icon w-embed">
            <svg width="100%" height="100%" viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                 fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
              <path d="M3.75 12L20.25 12"
                    stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"
                    stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path>
              <path d="M13.5 5.25L20.25 12L13.5 18.75"
                    stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"
                    stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path>
            </svg>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </a>
  `;
}

function formatCompensation(amount) {
  if (amount == null || amount === 0) return "0";

  if (amount >= 1000000) {
    const value = Math.floor((amount / 1000000) * 10) / 10;
    return `${value % 1 === 0 ? value : value.toFixed(1)}M`;
  }

  if (amount >= 1000) {
    const value = Math.floor((amount / 1000) * 10) / 10;
    return `${value % 1 === 0 ? value : value.toFixed(1)}K`;
  }

  return amount.toString();
}

function salary(tag, hourly, comp) {
  if (tag === "Core team") {
    if (!comp) return "";

    const min = formatCompensation(comp.min);
    const max = formatCompensation(comp.max);

    return `
      <div dataset-popover="wrapper" class="jobs_salary">
        <div>Compensation: <span class="job_salary-bold">$${min}-${max}/yr</span></div>
        <div dataset-popover="target" class="jobs_salary-trigger"></div>
        <div dataset-popover="item" class="popover_item is-salary">
          <div>Total compensation includes base salary, bonuses, and benefits.</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  if (hourly) {
    return `
      <div class="jobs_salary">
        <div>Pay: <span class="job_salary-bold">$${hourly.min}-${hourly.max}/h</span></div>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  return "";
}

function jobTag(tag) {
  const config = {
    "Core team": {
      className: "is-core",
      text: "This opening is for the micro1 core team as a full time employee",
    },
    "Extended team": {
      className: "is-extended",
      text: "As a contractor working with the micro1 core team closely",
    },
  };

  const item = config[tag];
  if (!item) return "";

  return `
    <div dataset-popover="wrapper" class="jobs_tag_wrap">
      <div dataset-popover="target" class="jobs_tag ${item.className}">
        ${tag}
      </div>
      <div dataset-popover="item" class="popover_item">${item.text}</div>
    </div>
  `;
}

function initPopover() {
  const jobList = state.els.wrapper;
  if (!jobList) return;

  const isMobile = window.matchMedia("(max-width: 991px)").matches;

  if (isMobile) {
    jobList.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      const target = event.target.closest("[dataset-popover='target']");
      if (!target) return;

      event.preventDefault();

      const wrapper = target.closest("[dataset-popover='wrapper']");
      wrapper?.classList.toggle("show-popover");
    });

    document.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      if (event.target.closest("[dataset-popover='target']")) return;

      document.querySelectorAll(".show-popover").forEach((element) => {
        element.classList.remove("show-popover");
      });
    });
  } else {
    jobList.addEventListener("mouseover", (event) => {
      const target = event.target.closest("[dataset-popover='target']");
      if (!target) return;

      target.closest("[dataset-popover='wrapper']")
        ?.classList.add("show-popover");
    });

    jobList.addEventListener("mouseout", (event) => {
      const target = event.target.closest("[dataset-popover='target']");
      if (!target) return;

      target.closest("[dataset-popover='wrapper']")
        ?.classList.remove("show-popover");
    });
  }
}

function initSearch() {
  if (state.els.formSearch) {
    state.els.formSearch.addEventListener("submit", (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      runSearch();
    });
  }

  if (state.els.inputSearch) {
    state.els.inputSearch.addEventListener("input", () => {
      clearTimeout(state.searchTimeout);

      state.searchTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
        runSearch();
      }, 300);
    });

    state.els.inputSearch.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.key === "Enter") {
        event.preventDefault();
        clearTimeout(state.searchTimeout);
        runSearch();
      }
    });
  }

  if (state.els.btnSearchSubmit) {
    state.els.btnSearchSubmit.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      clearTimeout(state.searchTimeout);
      runSearch();
    });
  }
}

function runSearch() {
  const keyword = state.els.inputSearch.value.trim();

  if (keyword === state.keyword) return;

  state.keyword = keyword;
  updateJobs();
}

function clearSearch() {
  clearTimeout(state.searchTimeout);

  state.els.inputSearch.value = "";
  state.keyword = "";

  updateJobs();
}

function listenerClearFilters() {
  document.querySelectorAll(
    ".jobs_result-clear, .job_result-0-clear, [clear-search]"
  ).forEach((element) => {
    // Avoid attaching duplicate listeners when the list is rerendered.
    if (element.dataset.clearSearchBound === "true") return;

    element.dataset.clearSearchBound = "true";

    element.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      clearSearch();
    });
  });
}

function setUTM() {
  let { cusRef, portalParams } = customTrackData;
  let finalString = portalParams || "";

  if (!finalString.includes("utm_source") && cusRef) {
    if (cusRef.includes("google")) cusRef = "google";

    finalString += `${finalString ? "&" : ""}utm_source=${encodeURIComponent(cusRef)}`;
  }

  state.trackingString = finalString;
}

function formatLink(href, queryString = state.trackingString) {
  if (!href) return "";

  const base = href.split("?")[0];
  return queryString ? `${base}?${queryString}` : base;
}
</script>

  const landingDomains = {
    production: "mindrift.ai",

    autotests: "mindrift.test.dev-tlk.toloka-test.network",
    localhost: "localhost",

  };

  const knownDomains = new Set(Object.values(landingDomains));

  const redirectToMindriftProxyIfNeeded = () => {
    const url = new URL(document.location.href);

    if (knownDomains.has(url.hostname)) {
      return;
    }

    const env = getEnvironment();

    url.hostname = landingDomains[env];

About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

Overview

You'll work directly with the world's leading AI organizations to build next-generation data solutions, managing expert teams across domains like finance, software engineering, and law to produce high-quality outputs at scale. You'll shape dataset specifications that directly influence how frontier models are evaluated and improved, owning critical projects end-to-end from scoping through delivery in a fast-moving, high-stakes environment. Along the way, you'll gain top-tier operational experience, working across multiple parts of the business — building, analyzing, coordinating, and executing wherever it's needed most.

Responsibilities

  • Project and client management: Work with the world’s leading AI organizations to build next-generation data solutions that push the limits of model capability, while directly driving revenue.

  • Manage expert teams across domains: Lead and coordinate highly specialized contributors across fields like finance, software engineering, law, and more to create high-quality outputs at scale.

  • Shape how AI systems are trained: Design dataset specifications that directly influence how frontier models are evaluated and improved. Your taste and judgement will shape what foundation models become.

  • Drive high-impact execution end-to-end: Own critical projects from idea to delivery. From scoping, executing, iterating, and shipping in a fast-moving, high-stakes environment, you will touch it all.

  • Gain top tier operational experience: Support the team across a range of operational initiatives that will directly contribute to the future of AfterQuery. You will work across multiple parts of the business in the same week, ranging from building, analyzing, coordinating, and executing where needed most.

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ YOE in a top-tier client-facing role (e.g., investment banking, consulting, private equity), as an ex-founder, or in the human-data industry

  • High agency, drive, and a strong work ethic; thrive in ambiguity and execute with minimal direction

  • Passion for AI and interest in entrepreneurship; enjoy experimenting with new tools (experience with Claude Code is a plus)

  • Competitive nature and demonstrated past success

  • Strong leadership experience and excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Thrive in fast-moving, high-impact environments with bias towards action, while balancing attention to detail

Preferred Qualifications

  • Technical skills (coding, scripting, or working with data) or experience using AI tools to automate workflows, conduct research, or build products

Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a workplace free from discrimination and harassment. Employment decisions are made without regard to legally protected characteristics under applicable federal, state, or local law.

We comply with applicable pay transparency requirements and provide compensation ranges based on the position, qualifications, experience, and other relevant factors. Reasonable accommodations are available to qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs, as required by law. This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed and is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, qualifications, or working conditions associated with the position. We reserve the right to modify this job description as business needs change.

About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

Overview

AfterQuery is hiring Growth Associates to architect and scale the expert supply engine powering frontier AI training. You will own both manual and automated acquisition pipelines to grow our expert network from 100K to hundreds of thousands and beyond. This role blends GTM automation engineering, talent acquisition, marketing, conference planning, partnership building, purchasing, and distribution.

This is not a typical “growth” role. It is an operational, and strategic position working directly with our founding team. You will design scalable systems, run experiments, recruit elite experts and operators, build automation stacks, represent AfterQuery at conferences and panels, and drive brand amplification / marketing initiatives.

Responsibilities

  • Build, optimize, and scale automated expert sourcing pipelines

  • Leverage LinkedIn and similar platforms to identify and bring on professionals from diverse industries

  • Lead purchasing efforts in the up and coming data acquisition field

  • Expand AfterQuery's Conference footprint

  • Expand Campus Partnership efforts with elite universities and MBA/PHD programs

  • Collaborate with Marketing to improve brand awareness and social media strategy

  • Work hand in hand with Engineering on Product Design Optimization

Required Qualifications

  • Experience scaling talent networks or marketplaces, recruiting, or outbound sales/lead generation

  • Scrappiness, thriving in ambiguity, and being able to overcome bottlenecks on the fly

  • Demonstrated track record of elite operational execution

  • Analytical rigor; comfort with funnel modeling and pipeline analytics

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication

  • Evidence of high agency, resourcefulness, and competitive drive

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency with GTM tooling (Clay, Instantly, Apollo, Zapier, scripts, scrapers)

  • Willingness to operate in a 5-6 day startup cadence

  • Passion for frontier AI and ambition to build category-defining systems

Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend

About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

AfterQuery is seeking exceptional undergraduate and masters students for our AI/ML Research Internship program. This is not a typical internship – you'll work directly with our research team on cutting-edge AI projects focused on advanced reasoning, computer use, and agentic models. You'll have access to our network of experts and specialized datasets to support your research contributions. Successful interns will have the opportunity to co-author research papers, gain invaluable experience with frontier AI systems, and potentially present work at leading AI conferences. Students enrolled in undergraduate or masters programs in relevant fields are welcome to apply. This job will demand between 10 and 40 hours per week depending on company needs.

Company Overview

AfterQuery is a research lab investigating the boundaries and capabilities of artificial intelligence through novel datasets and experimentation. Our customers are the foundation model labs, and we serve all of the frontier AI labs.

We are based in San Francisco, CA, and have raised funding from top investors, including Y Combinator and BoxGroup, ex-partners from Lightspeed and Index Ventures, and senior leadership at Google DeepMind and Meta GenAI.

Our founding team brings backgrounds from Jane Street, Meta, Citadel Securities, Google, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Silver Lake, Berkeley Artificial Intelligence Research (BAIR), and Stanford Artificial Intelligence Laboratory (SAIL).

Why Apply

  • Contribute to cutting-edge AI research

  • Co-author papers for top AI conferences

  • Access specialized datasets and computational resources

  • Develop highly sought-after industry and academic skills

  • Join one of the fastest growing YC startups

  • Work with AfterQuery’s founding team (Citadel Securities, Meta, Google, Silver Lake, Morgan Stanley)

Responsibilities

  • Support research scientists in designing and running experiments

  • Collect, process, and analyze proprietary datasets

  • Help develop and test new algorithms for advanced reasoning and agents

  • Contribute to research documentation and findings

  • Participate in research discussions and present findings

  • Collaborate on interdisciplinary projects with interns and researchers

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in AI, ML, or related research projects

  • Familiarity with large language models and reinforcement learning

  • Knowledge of NLP or multi-modal systems

  • Previous research experience or publications

  • Strong communication skills; able to explain complex concepts

  • Experience with data visualization and analysis tools

Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend

About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

Overview

Working with our core engineering team, you’ll be critical in creating data infrastructure that will be shaping the future development of frontier models. You will get a lot of responsibility, owning entire projects end-to-end – meaning you can see your impact instantly.

Responsibilities

  • Build and scale complex data capturing workflows across web (Next.js) and desktop (Python)

  • Architect and optimize data pipelines that experience high throughput, with heavy loads

  • Collaborate with the founding team to define product strategy and ship features fast.

  • Set engineering best practices and lay the groundwork for future team growth.

Required Qualifications

  • Able to take a gap semester off and join our team in person in San Francisco

  • Proficiency in JavaScript (Next.js) and Python, with demonstrated experience building full-stack web applications

  • Experience with serverless architecture and cloud functions for implementing heavy data processing (GCP/AWS)

  • Storage, caching & search: Hands‑on with Redis (caching), Elasticsearch (indexing), and message queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ) to build scalable, low‑latency pipelines.

  • Any background in AI research, LLM evaluation, or human‑in‑the‑loop systems

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience getting your ideas into production (founder experience preferred)

Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend

About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

Overview

As a Software Engineer - Platform Infrastructure at AfterQuery, you will design and build the core infrastructure that powers our data generation, evaluation, and agentic systems. You will be responsible for the shared platforms that enable our engineers and research teams to run large-scale human-in-the-loop workflows, evaluation harnesses, and automated data pipelines used to train frontier AI models. This is a highly technical role with broad ownership. You will architect and build foundational infrastructure that many other engineers depend on, ensuring systems are scalable, reliable, and capable of supporting extremely high-throughput workloads. You will work directly with the founding team to define system architecture, establish engineering best practices, and build the infrastructure that supports the next generation of AI development.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and develop the shared infrastructure powering our data generation platforms, human-in-the-loop systems, and evaluation pipelines.

  • Build systems capable of processing large-scale datasets and high-throughput workloads with strong reliability guarantees.

  • Create reusable infrastructure and APIs that enable product engineers and researchers to build quickly and reliably on top of core systems.

  • Design systems with strong observability, monitoring, and fault tolerance to support production workloads at scale.

  • Help define long-term system architecture across data pipelines, compute infrastructure, task orchestration, and storage systems.

  • Work closely with engineers and researchers to support new AI experimentation workflows and platform capabilities.

  • Define standards for system design, deployment, reliability, and infrastructure operations.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong experience building production distributed systems or platform infrastructure

  • Proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript (Node.js / Next.js) or similar backend technologies

  • Experience designing and operating systems in cloud environments (GCP or AWS)

  • Experience with message queues and event-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Pub/Sub, etc.)

  • Experience working with high-throughput data pipelines and asynchronous processing systems

  • Strong understanding of system scalability, performance, and reliability

  • Experience owning systems running in production environments

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building internal developer platforms or shared infrastructure

  • Experience supporting large-scale data processing pipelines

  • Experience with AI infrastructure, LLM evaluation systems, or ML pipelines

  • Experience working at high-growth startups or scaling early infrastructure

  • Experience designing human-in-the-loop or workflow orchestration systems

Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend
